zh.question: 求方程 $z^3=8i$ 的全部复数根。
zh.given: $z$ 是待求复数，$i$ 是虚数单位。右端 $8i$ 的模为 $8$、辐角为 $\pi/2$ 加整圈。
zh.goal: 找出三个互不相同的根，并写成直角坐标形式。

steps.title: 把右端写成极形式
steps.why: 复数乘方会把模乘方、把辐角相乘，所以先改写右端。
steps.work: $8i=8e^{i(\pi/2+2k\pi)}$，其中 $k\in\mathbb Z$ 表示任意整圈。

steps.title: 设未知数的极形式
steps.why: 这样可以分别比较等式两边的模和辐角。
steps.work: 令 $z=re^{i\theta}$，其中 $r\ge0$ 是模、$\theta$ 是辐角，则 $z^3=r^3e^{i3\theta}$。

steps.title: 分别解模和辐角
steps.why: 两个非零复数相等时，模相等，辐角相差整圈。

steps.title: 列出三个不同的根
steps.why: 辐角每增加 $2\pi/3$ 得到一个新根，三个以后开始重复。

check: 三个根的模都是 $2$，立方后的模都是 $2^3=8$。
三个辐角乘以 $3$ 后都与 $\pi/2$ 相差 $2\pi$ 的整数倍。
直接代入第三个根可得 $(-2i)^3=8i$。

en.question: Find every complex root of $z^3=8i$.
en.given: $z$ is the unknown complex number, and $i$ is the imaginary unit. The modulus of $8i$ is $8$, and its argument is $\pi/2$ plus whole turns.
en.goal: Find the three distinct roots and write them in Cartesian form.

steps.title: Write the right side in polar form
steps.why: A complex power raises the modulus and multiplies the argument, so first rewrite the right side.
steps.work: $8i=8e^{i(\pi/2+2k\pi)}$, where $k\in\mathbb Z$ represents any whole number of turns.

steps.title: Give the unknown a polar form
steps.why: This lets us compare the moduli and arguments separately.
steps.work: Let $z=re^{i\theta}$, where $r\ge0$ is the modulus and $\theta$ is an argument; then $z^3=r^3e^{i3\theta}$.

steps.title: Solve for modulus and argument
steps.why: Equal nonzero complex numbers have equal moduli and arguments differing by whole turns.

steps.title: List the three distinct roots
steps.why: Each increase of $2\pi/3$ gives a new root, and the values repeat after three roots.

check: All three roots have modulus $2$, so their cubes have modulus $2^3=8$.
Multiplying each argument by $3$ gives $\pi/2$ plus an integer multiple of $2\pi$.
Direct substitution of the third root gives $(-2i)^3=8i$.

zh.question: $\sqrt{z^2-1}$ 在哪些点有支点？无穷远是不是支点？
zh.given: $z$ 是复变量。绕支点一圈后，选定的函数值不能回到原值。
zh.goal: 找出有限支点，并单独判断无穷远。

steps.title: 分解根号内的式子
steps.why: 平方根在奇数阶零点附近会出现半整数次幂。
steps.work: $z^2-1=(z-1)(z+1)$，所以根号内在 $z=1$ 和 $z=-1$ 处各有一个一阶零点。

steps.title: 检查两个有限零点
steps.why: 局部的一次因子开平方后会在绕行一圈时变号。

steps.title: 把无穷远移到原点
steps.why: 令倒数变量趋于零，就能用普通局部分析判断无穷远。

steps.title: 判断无穷远
steps.why: 整数次幂绕一圈不变号，解析且非零的根号也可固定一个分支。
steps.work: 在 $w=0$ 附近，$\sqrt{1-w^2}$ 可取解析分支，而 $w^{-1}$ 是整数次幂，所以无穷远不是支点。

check: 绕 $z=1$ 或 $z=-1$ 一圈时，相应平方根因子变号。
绕 $w=0$ 一圈时，$w^{-1}$ 回到原值，因此无穷远没有分支交换。
可沿 $[-1,1]$ 取割线，把两个有限支点连接起来。

en.question: Where are the branch points of $\sqrt{z^2-1}$, and is infinity a branch point?
en.given: $z$ is a complex variable. After one circuit around a branch point, a chosen value cannot return to itself.
en.goal: Find the finite branch points and test infinity separately.

steps.title: Factor the expression under the root
steps.why: A square root develops a half-integer power near a zero of odd order.
steps.work: $z^2-1=(z-1)(z+1)$, so the expression under the root has simple zeros at $z=1$ and $z=-1$.

steps.title: Test the two finite zeros
steps.why: The square root of a local linear factor changes sign after one circuit.
steps.work: Near $z=1$, the function contains $(z-1)^{1/2}$; near $z=-1$, it contains $(z+1)^{1/2}$, so the finite branch points are $z=\pm1$.

steps.title: Move infinity to the origin
steps.why: Making a reciprocal variable tend to zero turns the test at infinity into an ordinary local test.
steps.work: Let $w=1/z$; then $\sqrt{z^2-1}=w^{-1}\sqrt{1-w^2}$, and infinity corresponds to $w=0$.

steps.title: Decide what happens at infinity
steps.why: An integer power does not change sign after a circuit, and the nonzero square root can use one analytic branch.
steps.work: Near $w=0$, choose an analytic branch of $\sqrt{1-w^2}$; since $w^{-1}$ is an integer power, infinity is not a branch point.

check: A circuit around $z=1$ or $z=-1$ changes the sign of the corresponding square-root factor.
A circuit around $w=0$ returns $w^{-1}$ to its original value, so no sheets exchange at infinity.
A valid branch cut is $[-1,1]$, which joins the two finite branch points.

zh.question: 已知解析函数 $f(z)=u(x,y)+iv(x,y)$ 的实部为 $u=x^2-y^2$，且 $f(0)=0$，求 $f(z)$。
zh.given: $z=x+iy$，$u$ 和 $v$ 分别是实部与虚部。解析函数满足 $u_x=v_y$ 和 $u_y=-v_x$。
zh.goal: 先求调和共轭 $v$，再把结果写成 $z$ 的函数。

steps.title: 求实部的偏导
steps.why: 柯西–黎曼方程把已知的 $u$ 与未知的 $v$ 联系起来。

steps.title: 用第一条方程积分
steps.why: 由 $v_y=u_x$ 可以先沿 $y$ 方向恢复 $v$。
steps.work: $v_y=2x$，对 $y$ 积分得 $v=2xy+g(x)$；$g(x)$ 是积分时可能漏下的任意函数。

steps.title: 用第二条方程定函数
steps.why: 另一条柯西–黎曼方程会消除多余的 $g(x)$。

steps.title: 使用初值并合并
steps.why: 初值决定最后的实常数 $C$。

check: 结果 $f=z^2$ 的实部确实是 $x^2-y^2$。
所得 $v=2xy$ 满足 $v_y=2x=u_x$ 和 $v_x=2y=-u_y$。

en.question: An analytic function $f(z)=u(x,y)+iv(x,y)$ has real part $u=x^2-y^2$ and satisfies $f(0)=0$; find $f(z)$.
en.given: $z=x+iy$, and $u$ and $v$ are the real and imaginary parts. An analytic function satisfies $u_x=v_y$ and $u_y=-v_x$.
en.goal: Find the harmonic conjugate $v$, then write the result as a function of $z$.

steps.title: Differentiate the real part
steps.why: The Cauchy–Riemann equations connect the known function $u$ to the unknown function $v$.

steps.title: Integrate the first equation
steps.why: The equation $v_y=u_x$ lets us integrate first in the $y$ direction and recover $v$.
steps.work: $v_y=2x$, so integration with respect to $y$ gives $v=2xy+g(x)$; $g(x)$ is the arbitrary function left by the integration.

steps.title: Use the second equation
steps.why: The other Cauchy–Riemann equation removes the extra freedom in $g(x)$.

steps.title: Apply the initial value and combine
steps.why: The initial value determines the remaining real constant $C$.

check: The real part of $f=z^2$ is exactly $x^2-y^2$.
Substitution of $z=0$ gives $f(0)=0$.
The result $v=2xy$ satisfies $v_y=2x=u_x$ and $v_x=2y=-u_y$.

zh.question: 对 $f(z)=z^2=u(x,y)+iv(x,y)$，说明 $u$ 与 $v$ 的等值线为什么在非原点处互相垂直。
zh.given: $z=x+iy$。等值线的梯度是它的法向量，两个非零法向量内积为零时两条曲线垂直。
zh.goal: 算出两个梯度并检验它们的内积。

steps.title: 分离实部和虚部
steps.why: 等值线分别由 $u$ 和 $v$ 决定，必须先把它们写出来。

steps.title: 计算两个梯度
steps.why: 梯度给出每族等值线在该点的法向方向。

steps.title: 计算内积
steps.why: 内积为零正是两个法向量正交的代数判据。

steps.title: 排除退化点
steps.why: 零向量没有方向，不能拿来判断曲线切线。
steps.work:
当 $(x,y)
e(0,0)$ 时，$|
abla u|=|
abla v|=2\sqrt{x^2+y^2}>0$，因此两族等值线互相垂直。

check: 在原点两梯度都为零，所以结论必须写成“在非原点处”。
$u$ 与 $v$ 都满足二维拉普拉斯方程，符合解析函数实虚部的性质。

en.question: For $f(z)=z^2=u(x,y)+iv(x,y)$, explain why the level curves of $u$ and $v$ are perpendicular away from the origin.
en.given: $z=x+iy$. The gradient of a level curve is its normal, and two curves are perpendicular when their nonzero normals have zero dot product.
en.goal: Compute the two gradients and test their dot product.

steps.title: Separate real and imaginary parts
steps.why: The two level-curve families are defined by $u$ and $v$, so first write both functions explicitly.

steps.title: Compute both gradients
steps.why: Each gradient gives the normal direction of its level curve at the point.

steps.title: Take the dot product
steps.why: A zero dot product is the algebraic test for perpendicular normal vectors.

steps.title: Exclude the degenerate point
steps.why: A zero vector has no direction and cannot determine a curve tangent.
steps.work:
When $(x,y)
e(0,0)$, $|
abla u|=|
abla v|=2\sqrt{x^2+y^2}>0$, so the two level-curve families are perpendicular.

check: At $(1,0)$, the two normal vectors are $(2,0)$ and $(0,2)$.
At the origin both gradients vanish, so the conclusion must say 'away from the origin.'
Both $u$ and $v$ satisfy the two-dimensional Laplace equation, as real and imaginary parts of an analytic function should.

zh.question: 沿圆 $|z|=2$ 逆时针计算 $\displaystyle\oint_{|z|=2}\frac{e^z}{z^3}\,dz$。
zh.given: 积分路径包围 $z=0$。高阶柯西公式为 $\displaystyle\oint_C\frac{f(z)}{(z-a)^{n+1}}\,dz=\frac{2\pi i}{n!}f^{(n)}(a)$。
zh.goal: 识别导数阶数并算出积分。

steps.title: 匹配公式的分母
steps.why: 导数阶数由分母指数减一得到。

steps.title: 计算需要的导数
steps.why: 公式要求的是二阶导数在圆内点 $a=0$ 的值。

steps.title: 代入高阶柯西公式
steps.why: 路径逆时针且 $z=0$ 在圆内，可以直接使用正号公式。

check: 用留数检查得到 $2\pi i\times(1/2)=\pi i$。
若把 $z^3$ 误认成三阶导数，会多算一阶。

en.question: Along $|z|=2$, evaluate $\displaystyle\oint_{|z|=2}\frac{e^z}{z^3}\,dz$ counterclockwise.
en.given: The contour encloses $z=0$. The generalized Cauchy formula is $\displaystyle\oint_C\frac{f(z)}{(z-a)^{n+1}}\,dz=\frac{2\pi i}{n!}f^{(n)}(a)$.
en.goal: Identify the derivative order and evaluate the integral.

steps.title: Match the denominator to the formula
steps.why: The derivative order is one less than the denominator exponent.
steps.work: $z^3=(z-0)^{2+1}$, so $a=0$, $n=2$, and the numerator function is $f(z)=e^z$.

steps.title: Compute the required derivative
steps.why: The formula needs the second derivative at the enclosed point $a=0$.

steps.title: Substitute into Cauchy's formula
steps.why: The contour is counterclockwise and $z=0$ is inside, so the formula has its positive sign.

check: $e^z/z^3=z^{-3}+z^{-2}+\frac12z^{-1}+\cdots$, whose coefficient of the minus-first power is $1/2$.
The residue check gives $2\pi i\times(1/2)=\pi i$.
Treating $z^3$ as a third derivative would introduce one derivative too many.

zh.question: 在区域 $|z|>1$ 中，把 $\displaystyle\frac1{1+z}$ 展开成洛朗级数。
zh.given: 几何级数 $\displaystyle\frac1{1+q}=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}(-1)^nq^n$ 只在 $|q|<1$ 时成立。
zh.goal: 选出在给定区域内小于 $1$ 的展开变量，并写明收敛域。

steps.title: 根据区域选择小量
steps.why: $|z|>1$ 时 $z$ 不小，但 $z^{-1}$ 的模小于一。
steps.work: $|z|>1\Rightarrow|z^{-1}|<1$，所以要用 $z^{-1}$ 作几何级数的变量。

steps.title: 从分母提出 $z$
steps.why: 提出 $z$ 后，分母就变成含小量 $z^{-1}$ 的形式。

steps.title: 套用几何级数
steps.why: 现在公比的模小于一，展开条件已经满足。

steps.title: 写出前几项和区域
steps.why: 前几项能看清幂次与正负号，收敛域是答案的一部分。

check: 原函数在 $z=-1$ 有奇点，所以以原点展开时边界半径应为 $1$。
所得级数只有负幂，符合外部区域 $|z|>1$ 的洛朗展开。

en.question: In the region $|z|>1$, expand $\displaystyle\frac1{1+z}$ as a Laurent series.
en.given: The geometric series $\displaystyle\frac1{1+q}=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}(-1)^nq^n$ is valid only when $|q|<1$.
en.goal: Choose an expansion variable whose modulus is below $1$ in the stated region, and give the convergence region.

steps.title: Choose the small quantity from the region
steps.why: When $|z|>1$, the quantity $z$ is not small, but the modulus of $z^{-1}$ is below one.
steps.work: $|z|>1\Rightarrow|z^{-1}|<1$, so use $z^{-1}$ as the geometric-series variable.

steps.title: Factor $z$ from the denominator
steps.why: After factoring $z$, the denominator contains the small quantity $z^{-1}$.

steps.title: Apply the geometric series
steps.why: The new ratio has modulus below one, so the expansion condition now holds.

steps.title: Show the first terms and region
steps.why: The first terms display the powers and signs, and the convergence region belongs in the answer.

check: At $z=2$, the series becomes $1/2-1/4+1/8-\cdots=1/3$.
The original function is singular at $z=-1$, so an expansion about the origin should have boundary radius $1$.
The series contains only negative powers, as expected for the outer region $|z|>1$.

zh.question: 判断 $\displaystyle\frac{\sin z}{z}$ 在 $z=0$ 处的奇点类型，并给出可解析延拓时的补值。
zh.given: 分子和分母在 $z=0$ 都为零，不能只看分母就判断极点。
zh.goal: 用局部级数判断是否存在负幂，并求极限值。

steps.title: 展开分子
steps.why: 泰勒级数能直接显示零点阶数和局部幂次。

steps.title: 逐项除以 $z$
steps.why: 约去共同的一阶零点后，就能看出是否还有发散项。

steps.title: 判断奇点类型
steps.why: 洛朗级数没有负幂时，孤立奇点可以通过补值去掉。
steps.work: 展开式没有任何负幂，且 $\displaystyle\lim_{z\to0}\frac{\sin z}{z}=1$，所以 $z=0$ 是可去奇点。

steps.title: 写出延拓值
steps.why: 把缺失点补成极限值后，级数在原点仍然解析。
steps.work: 定义 $f(0)=1$，则延拓后的 $f(z)$ 在整个复平面解析。

check: 补值后的级数首项为 $1$，所以函数在 $z=0$ 连续。
展开中没有 $(z-0)^{-1}$ 或更低幂，因此不是极点也不是本性奇点。
沿实轴取极限也得到 $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\sin x}{x}=1$。

en.question: Classify the singularity of $\displaystyle\frac{\sin z}{z}$ at $z=0$, and give the value for an analytic extension if one exists.
en.given: Both numerator and denominator vanish at $z=0$, so the denominator alone cannot identify a pole.
en.goal: Use a local series to test for negative powers and find the limiting value.

steps.title: Expand the numerator
steps.why: The Taylor series directly displays the zero order and all local powers.

steps.title: Divide each term by $z$
steps.why: After canceling the common simple zero, we can see whether any divergent terms remain.

steps.title: Classify the singularity
steps.why: When the Laurent series has no negative powers, the isolated singularity can be removed by filling in a value.
steps.work: There are no negative powers, and $\displaystyle\lim_{z\to0}\frac{\sin z}{z}=1$, so $z=0$ is removable.

steps.title: State the extension value
steps.why: Filling in the limiting value keeps the power series analytic at the origin.
steps.work: Define $f(0)=1$; the extended $f(z)$ is then analytic on the entire complex plane.

check: The extended series begins with $1$, so the function is continuous at $z=0$.
No term $(z-0)^{-1}$ or lower occurs, so the point is neither a pole nor an essential singularity.
The real-axis limit also gives $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\sin x}{x}=1$.

zh.question: 求 $\displaystyle f(z)=\frac{e^z}{(z-1)^2}$ 在 $z=1$ 处的留数。
zh.given: $z=1$ 是二阶极点。若 $a$ 是 $m$ 阶极点，则 $\displaystyle\operatorname{Res}_{z=a}f=\frac1{(m-1)!}\left[\frac{d^{m-1}}{dz^{m-1}}(z-a)^mf(z)\right]_{z=a}$。
zh.goal: 正确使用二阶极点公式，找出负一次幂的系数。

steps.title: 确定极点阶数
steps.why: 阶数决定要乘回多少因子以及求几次导数。

steps.title: 乘回极点因子
steps.why: 这样会留下在 $z=1$ 附近解析的函数。

steps.title: 求一次导数并代入
steps.why: $m-1=1$，因此二阶极点只要求一次导数。

en.question: Find the residue of $\displaystyle f(z)=\frac{e^z}{(z-1)^2}$ at $z=1$.
en.given: $z=1$ is a second-order pole. If $a$ is a pole of order $m$, then $\displaystyle\operatorname{Res}_{z=a}f=\frac1{(m-1)!}\left[\frac{d^{m-1}}{dz^{m-1}}(z-a)^mf(z)\right]_{z=a}$.
en.goal: Apply the second-order pole formula correctly and find the coefficient of the minus-first power.

steps.title: Identify the pole order
steps.why: The order determines how many factors to cancel and how many derivatives to take.
steps.work: The denominator is $(z-1)^2$ and $e^1\ne0$, so $a=1$ and $m=2$.

steps.title: Cancel the pole factor
steps.why: This leaves a function analytic near $z=1$.

steps.title: Differentiate once and substitute
steps.why: Because $m-1=1$, a second-order pole requires only one derivative.

check: After division by $(z-1)^2$, the coefficient of $(z-1)^{-1}$ is exactly $e$.
The denominator in the formula is $(m-1)!=1!$, not $2!$.

zh.question: 计算 $\displaystyle I=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{dx}{x^2+a^2}$，其中 $a>0$。
zh.given: 把实变量换成复变量 $z$，并取上半平面半圆围道。圆弧半径记为 $R$，最后令 $R\to\infty$。
zh.goal: 找出围道内的极点，证明大圆弧积分消失，再用留数定理求 $I$。

steps.title: 分解分母
steps.why: 因式分解能直接显示复平面中的极点位置。

steps.title: 选择围道内的极点
steps.why: $a>0$ 时只有 $z=ia$ 位于上半平面。
steps.work: 上半圆围道只包围 $z=ia$，而 $z=-ia$ 在下半平面外。

steps.title: 计算留数
steps.why: $z=ia$ 是一阶极点，可以约去对应的一次因子后代入。

steps.title: 估计大圆弧
steps.why: 只有证明圆弧部分趋于零，围道积分才能化成原实积分。
steps.work: 在 $|z|=R>a$ 上，$|z^2+a^2|\ge R^2-a^2$，故圆弧积分的模不超过 $\displaystyle\frac{\pi R}{R^2-a^2}\to0$。

steps.title: 使用留数定理
steps.why: 令 $R\to\infty$ 后，闭合围道中只剩实轴积分。

check: 被积函数在实轴上为正，所以结果 $\pi/a$ 也应为正。
令 $a=1$，得到熟悉的 $\displaystyle\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{dx}{1+x^2}=\pi$。
量纲上，被积函数积分后的量纲是 $1/a$，与 $\pi/a$ 一致。

en.question: Evaluate $\displaystyle I=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{dx}{x^2+a^2}$, where $a>0$.
en.given: Replace the real variable by the complex variable $z$ and use an upper-half-plane semicircular contour. Let the arc radius be $R$, then take $R\to\infty$.
en.goal: Find the pole inside the contour, prove that the large-arc integral vanishes, and use the residue theorem to find $I$.

steps.title: Factor the denominator
steps.why: Factoring directly displays the pole locations in the complex plane.

steps.title: Select the enclosed pole
steps.why: Because $a>0$, only $z=ia$ lies in the upper half-plane.
steps.work: The upper semicircular contour encloses $z=ia$, while $z=-ia$ lies outside in the lower half-plane.

steps.title: Compute the residue
steps.why: $z=ia$ is a simple pole, so cancel its linear factor and substitute.

steps.title: Bound the large arc
steps.why: The contour integral becomes the original real integral only after the arc term is shown to vanish.
steps.work: On $|z|=R>a$, $|z^2+a^2|\ge R^2-a^2$, so the arc integral has modulus at most $\displaystyle\frac{\pi R}{R^2-a^2}\to0$.

steps.title: Apply the residue theorem
steps.why: After $R\to\infty$, only the real-axis integral remains in the closed contour.

check: The real integrand is positive, so the result $\pi/a$ should also be positive.
For $a=1$, this gives the familiar result $\displaystyle\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{dx}{1+x^2}=\pi$.
Dimensionally, the integral has units of $1/a$, matching $\pi/a$.

zh.question: 判断 $f(z)=1/(z+i)$ 是否满足上半平面色散关系所需的解析性与衰减条件，并在 $x=0$ 检查实部、虚部公式的符号。
zh.given: 在实轴上写 $f(x)=u(x)+iv(x)$。采用 $u(x)=\frac1\pi\operatorname{PV}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{v(t)}{t-x}\,dt$ 和 $v(x)=-\frac1\pi\operatorname{PV}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{u(t)}{t-x}\,dt$。
zh.goal: 先检查函数条件，再用 $x=0$ 的直接积分核对两个符号。

steps.title: 找出极点位置
steps.why: 上半平面内不能有极点，否则不能直接使用该色散关系。
steps.work: $f(z)=1/(z+i)$ 的唯一极点满足 $z+i=0$，即 $z=-i$，它位于下半平面。

steps.title: 检查无穷远衰减
steps.why: 足够快的衰减能让闭合围道的大圆弧部分消失。
steps.work: 当 $|z|\to\infty$ 时，$f(z)=O(1/z)$；色散积分中的 $f(z)/(z-x)=O(1/z^2)$。

steps.title: 分离实部和虚部
steps.why: 两个色散公式分别使用 $u$ 与 $v$，所以先把它们显式写出。

steps.title: 检查实部公式
steps.why: 在 $x=0$ 时，被积函数的奇偶性可以立刻给出主值。

steps.title: 检查虚部公式
steps.why: 第二式前面的负号必须通过实际代入确认。

check: 极点 $z=-i$ 不在上半平面，所以解析性条件满足。
$u(x)$ 是奇函数、$v(x)$ 是偶函数，和分解结果一致。
在 $x=0$ 得到 $u(0)=0$、$v(0)=-1$，两条公式的符号都吻合。

en.question: Determine whether $f(z)=1/(z+i)$ satisfies the analyticity and decay conditions for upper-half-plane dispersion relations, and check the signs of the real- and imaginary-part formulas at $x=0$.
en.given: On the real axis, write $f(x)=u(x)+iv(x)$. Use $u(x)=\frac1\pi\operatorname{PV}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{v(t)}{t-x}\,dt$ and $v(x)=-\frac1\pi\operatorname{PV}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{u(t)}{t-x}\,dt$.
en.goal: Check the function conditions first, then verify both signs by direct integration at $x=0$.

steps.title: Locate the pole
steps.why: The upper half-plane must contain no pole if this dispersion relation is to be used directly.
steps.work: The only pole of $f(z)=1/(z+i)$ satisfies $z+i=0$, so $z=-i$, which lies in the lower half-plane.

steps.title: Check decay at infinity
steps.why: Sufficient decay makes the large-arc contribution of the closed contour vanish.

steps.title: Separate real and imaginary parts
steps.why: The two dispersion formulas use $u$ and $v$ separately, so first write them explicitly.

steps.title: Check the real-part formula
steps.why: At $x=0$, parity immediately evaluates the principal value.

steps.title: Check the imaginary-part formula
steps.why: Direct substitution must confirm the minus sign in the second formula.

check: The pole $z=-i$ is outside the upper half-plane, so the analyticity condition holds.
$u(x)$ is odd and $v(x)$ is even, matching the decomposition.
At $x=0$, the results are $u(0)=0$ and $v(0)=-1$, so both formula signs agree.

zh.question: 把 $f(x)=x$ 在区间 $(-\pi,\pi)$ 上展开成傅里叶级数。
zh.given: 采用 $f(x)=\frac{a_0}{2}+\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}[a_n\cos(nx)+b_n\sin(nx)]$。系数在 $(-\pi,\pi)$ 上计算。
zh.goal: 利用奇偶性减少积分，再算出所有非零系数。

steps.title: 先看奇偶性
steps.why: 奇偶性可以不用积分就消去一半系数。

steps.title: 写出正弦系数
steps.why: $x\sin(nx)$ 是偶函数，可把对称区间积分化成两倍半区间积分。

steps.title: 做分部积分
steps.why: 积分中含有 $x$ 乘三角函数，分部积分可以去掉 $x$。

steps.title: 得到系数
steps.why: 把刚算出的积分乘回系数公式中的 $2/\pi$。

steps.title: 写出最终级数
steps.why: 只有正弦项非零，把 $b_n$ 代回原展开式即可。

check: 右端只含正弦项，因此它是奇函数，与 $f(x)=x$ 一致。
取 $n=1$ 得 $b_1=2$，直接计算 $\frac2\pi\int_0^\pi x\sin x\,dx$ 也等于 $2$。
周期接缝两侧极限为 $\pi$ 和 $-\pi$，平均值是 $0$。

en.question: Expand $f(x)=x$ in a Fourier series on $(-\pi,\pi)$.
en.given: Use $f(x)=\frac{a_0}{2}+\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}[a_n\cos(nx)+b_n\sin(nx)]$. Compute the coefficients on $(-\pi,\pi)$.
en.goal: Use parity to reduce the integrations, then compute every nonzero coefficient.

steps.title: Check parity first
steps.why: Parity removes half the coefficients without integration.

steps.title: Write the sine coefficient
steps.why: $x\sin(nx)$ is even, so a symmetric-interval integral becomes twice the half-interval integral.

steps.title: Integrate by parts
steps.why: The integrand is $x$ times a trigonometric function, so integration by parts removes $x$.

steps.title: Obtain the coefficient
steps.why: Multiply the integral just found by the factor $2/\pi$ in the coefficient formula.

steps.title: Write the final series
steps.why: Only sine terms remain, so substitute $b_n$ into the original expansion.
steps.work: $\displaystyle x=2\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{(-1)^{n+1}}n\sin(nx)$ for $-\pi<x<\pi$; at the endpoints the series converges to $0$.

check: The right side contains only sine terms, so it is odd like $f(x)=x$.
For $n=1$, $b_1=2$, and direct calculation of $\frac2\pi\int_0^\pi x\sin x\,dx$ also gives $2$.
The periodic seam has side limits $\pi$ and $-\pi$, whose average is $0$.

zh.question: 在约定 $F(k)=\displaystyle\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}f(x)e^{-ikx}\,dx$ 下，求 $f(x)=e^{-a|x|}$ 的傅里叶变换，其中 $a>0$。
zh.given: $a>0$ 保证函数在无穷远衰减。$k$ 是实频率变量。
zh.goal: 利用偶性把积分减半，再算出显式的频谱。

steps.title: 利用函数的偶性
steps.why: 偶函数乘正弦得到奇函数，虚部在对称区间积分为零。

steps.title: 改成复指数积分
steps.why: 指数函数容易直接积分，最后只需取实部。

steps.title: 计算指数积分
steps.why: $a>0$ 使上限处的指数趋于零。

steps.title: 取实部并乘二
steps.why: 有理化后可以直接读出实部。

check: $F(k)$ 是实偶函数，符合实偶原函数的变换性质。
$F(0)=2/a$，等于 $\displaystyle\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}e^{-a|x|}\,dx=2/a$。
当 $|k|\to\infty$ 时 $F(k)\to0$，符合可积函数频谱衰减的预期。

en.question: Under the convention $F(k)=\displaystyle\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}f(x)e^{-ikx}\,dx$, find the Fourier transform of $f(x)=e^{-a|x|}$, where $a>0$.
en.given: $a>0$ ensures decay at infinity. $k$ is the real frequency variable.
en.goal: Use evenness to halve the work, then compute the spectrum explicitly.

steps.title: Use evenness
steps.why: An even function times sine is odd, so the imaginary part integrates to zero on a symmetric interval.
steps.work: $f(x)$ is real and even, so $F(k)=2\int_0^\infty e^{-ax}\cos(kx)\,dx$.

steps.title: Use a complex exponential integral
steps.why: The exponential is easy to integrate, and only its real part is needed afterward.

steps.title: Evaluate the exponential integral
steps.why: $a>0$ makes the exponential vanish at the upper limit.

steps.title: Take the real part and double
steps.why: Rationalizing makes the real part visible immediately.

check: $F(k)$ is real and even, as expected for a real even original function.
$F(0)=2/a$, equal to $\displaystyle\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}e^{-a|x|}\,dx=2/a$.
As $|k|\to\infty$, $F(k)\to0$, as expected for the spectrum of an integrable function.

zh.question: 已知 $\widehat{e^{-x^2}}=\sqrt\pi e^{-k^2/4}$，求 $g(x)=e^{-(x-a)^2}$ 的傅里叶变换。
zh.given: 采用 $\widehat f(k)=\displaystyle\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}f(x)e^{-ikx}\,dx$，并设 $a$ 为实常数。
zh.goal: 识别平移并得到含相位因子的频谱。

steps.title: 识别原函数和平移
steps.why: 题目已给标准高斯的变换，不需要重新完成高斯积分。
steps.work: 令 $f(x)=e^{-x^2}$，则 $g(x)=f(x-a)$，表示图像向右平移 $a$。

steps.title: 从定义换元
steps.why: 换元能看清平移如何变成指数因子。

steps.title: 提出与积分无关的因子
steps.why: $e^{-ika}$ 不含积分变量，可以移到积分号外。

steps.title: 代入已知高斯变换
steps.why: 把题目给出的 $F(k)$ 直接放入平移公式。

check: $|e^{-ika}|=1$，所以平移前后频谱的模相同。
令 $a=0$，结果退化为 $\sqrt\pi e^{-k^2/4}$。
令 $k=0$，得到 $G(0)=\sqrt\pi$，与高斯函数的总面积不随平移改变一致。

en.question: Given $\widehat{e^{-x^2}}=\sqrt\pi e^{-k^2/4}$, find the Fourier transform of $g(x)=e^{-(x-a)^2}$.
en.given: Use $\widehat f(k)=\displaystyle\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}f(x)e^{-ikx}\,dx$, and let $a$ be real.
en.goal: Recognize the translation and obtain the spectrum with its phase factor.

steps.title: Identify the original function and shift
steps.why: The transform of the standard Gaussian is already given, so the Gaussian integral need not be repeated.
steps.work: Let $f(x)=e^{-x^2}$; then $g(x)=f(x-a)$, which shifts the graph right by $a$.

steps.title: Substitute in the definition
steps.why: A substitution shows exactly how the translation becomes an exponential factor.

steps.title: Take out the constant factor
steps.why: $e^{-ika}$ contains no integration variable, so it can be moved outside the integral.

steps.title: Insert the known Gaussian transform
steps.why: Substitute the supplied $F(k)$ into the translation formula.

check: $|e^{-ika}|=1$, so translation leaves the spectrum magnitude unchanged.
For $a=0$, the result reduces to $\sqrt\pi e^{-k^2/4}$.
For $k=0$, $G(0)=\sqrt\pi$, consistent with translation preserving the total area of a Gaussian.

zh.question: 计算 $\displaystyle\int_{-2}^{2}(1+x^2)\delta(x^2-1)\,dx$。
zh.given: 若 $g(x_i)=0$ 且 $g'(x_i)\ne0$，则 $\displaystyle\delta(g(x))=\sum_i\frac{\delta(x-x_i)}{|g'(x_i)|}$。只保留积分区间内的根。
zh.goal: 找全零点，计算导数权重，再使用抽样性质。

steps.title: 求根号内函数的零点
steps.why: $\delta(g(x))$ 只会在 $g(x)=0$ 的位置产生贡献。

steps.title: 计算每个根的权重
steps.why: 复合变量的 $\delta$ 函数必须除以导数绝对值。

steps.title: 展开复合 $\delta$ 函数
steps.why: 把它写成普通点质量后即可逐点抽样。

steps.title: 代入两个抽样点
steps.why: 每个 $\delta$ 项把权函数 $1+x^2$ 取在自己的根上。

check: 两个根都在积分区间内，不能漏掉 $x=-1$。
两个权重都含 $|g'(x_i)|=2$，绝对值保证权重为正。
被积权函数在两个根处都等于 $2$，最终两个贡献相等。

en.question: Evaluate $\displaystyle\int_{-2}^{2}(1+x^2)\delta(x^2-1)\,dx$.
en.given: If $g(x_i)=0$ and $g'(x_i)\ne0$, then $\displaystyle\delta(g(x))=\sum_i\frac{\delta(x-x_i)}{|g'(x_i)|}$. Keep only roots inside the integration interval.
en.goal: Find every root, compute the derivative weights, and apply the sampling property.

steps.title: Find the zeros of the inner function
steps.why: $\delta(g(x))$ contributes only where $g(x)=0$.
steps.work: Let $g(x)=x^2-1$; solving $g(x)=0$ gives $x_1=1$ and $x_2=-1$, both inside $[-2,2]$.

steps.title: Compute the weight at each root
steps.why: A composite $\delta$ function must be divided by the absolute derivative.

steps.title: Expand the composite $\delta$ function
steps.why: Writing it as ordinary point masses makes direct sampling possible.

steps.title: Evaluate at both sampling points
steps.why: Each $\delta$ term evaluates the weight $1+x^2$ at its own root.

check: Both roots lie in the integration interval, so $x=-1$ must not be omitted.
Both weights contain $|g'(x_i)|=2$, and the absolute value keeps them positive.
The weight function equals $2$ at both roots, so the two final contributions are equal.

zh.question: 求 $\mathcal L[te^{2t}]$，并写出收敛条件。
zh.given: 拉普拉斯变换定义为 $F(p)=\mathcal L[f(t)]=\displaystyle\int_0^\infty e^{-pt}f(t)\,dt$。性质为 $\mathcal L[tf(t)]=-F'(p)$。
zh.goal: 从指数函数的已知变换出发，用求导性质得到答案。

steps.title: 先变换指数函数
steps.why: $te^{2t}$ 是在 $e^{2t}$ 前乘了 $t$，所以先求后者的变换。

steps.title: 使用乘 $t$ 的性质
steps.why: 时域乘 $t$ 对应像函数对 $p$ 求导并加负号。

steps.title: 完成求导
steps.why: 幂函数求导产生的负号会与性质中的负号抵消。

steps.title: 保留收敛条件
steps.why: 多项式因子 $t$ 不会改变由指数增长率决定的收敛边界。
steps.work: 最终结果是 $\displaystyle\mathcal L[te^{2t}]=\frac1{(p-2)^2}$，仍要求 $\operatorname{Re}p>2$。

check: 直接令 $q=p-2$，可得 $\displaystyle\int_0^\infty te^{-qt}\,dt=1/q^2$。
当实数 $p>2$ 时，结果为正，符合正被积函数。
若漏掉性质中的负号，会得到错误的负结果。

en.question: Find $\mathcal L[te^{2t}]$ and state its convergence condition.
en.given: The Laplace transform is $F(p)=\mathcal L[f(t)]=\displaystyle\int_0^\infty e^{-pt}f(t)\,dt$. The relevant property is $\mathcal L[tf(t)]=-F'(p)$.
en.goal: Start from the known transform of an exponential and use the differentiation property.

steps.title: Transform the exponential first
steps.why: $te^{2t}$ is $e^{2t}$ multiplied by $t$, so first transform the exponential alone.

steps.title: Use the multiplication-by-$t$ property
steps.why: Multiplication by $t$ in the time domain means differentiating with respect to $p$ and adding a minus sign.

steps.title: Carry out the derivative
steps.why: The minus sign from differentiating the power cancels the minus sign in the property.

steps.title: Keep the convergence condition
steps.why: The polynomial factor $t$ does not change the boundary set by exponential growth.
steps.work: The final result is $\displaystyle\mathcal L[te^{2t}]=\frac1{(p-2)^2}$, still requiring $\operatorname{Re}p>2$.

check: Setting $q=p-2$ directly gives $\displaystyle\int_0^\infty te^{-qt}\,dt=1/q^2$.
For real $p>2$, the result is positive, as the positive integrand requires.
Omitting the minus sign in the property would produce an incorrect negative answer.

zh.question: 用拉普拉斯变换解初值问题 $y'(t)+y(t)=1$，$y(0)=0$。
zh.given: 设 $Y(p)=\mathcal L[y(t)]$。使用 $\mathcal L[y']=pY(p)-y(0)$ 和 $\mathcal L[1]=1/p$。
zh.goal: 把微分方程变成代数方程，求出 $Y(p)$，再作逆变换。

steps.title: 对方程逐项变换
steps.why: 拉普拉斯变换把导数变成含 $p$ 的代数项，并自动带入初值。

steps.title: 代入初值并解 $Y$
steps.why: 使用 $y(0)=0$ 后只剩一个关于 $Y(p)$ 的一次代数方程。

steps.title: 作部分分式分解
steps.why: 拆成变换表中的基本形式后才能直接逆变换。

steps.title: 逐项逆变换
steps.why: $1/p$ 和 $1/(p+1)$ 分别对应常数函数和衰减指数。

steps.title: 代回原方程
steps.why: 逆变换后必须同时检查微分方程和初值。

check: 把 $t=0$ 代入得到 $y(0)=0$，初值满足。
把 $y=1-e^{-t}$ 代入左端得到恒等的 $1$。
当 $t\to\infty$ 时 $y(t)\to1$，与方程的稳定平衡值一致。

en.question: Use the Laplace transform to solve the initial-value problem $y'(t)+y(t)=1$, $y(0)=0$.
en.given: Let $Y(p)=\mathcal L[y(t)]$. Use $\mathcal L[y']=pY(p)-y(0)$ and $\mathcal L[1]=1/p$.
en.goal: Turn the differential equation into an algebraic equation, solve for $Y(p)$, and invert the transform.

steps.title: Transform each term
steps.why: The Laplace transform turns the derivative into an algebraic term in $p$ and includes the initial value automatically.

steps.title: Insert the initial value and solve for $Y$
steps.why: After using $y(0)=0$, only a linear algebraic equation for $Y(p)$ remains.

steps.title: Use partial fractions
steps.why: Splitting the expression into standard table entries makes inversion immediate.
steps.work: $\displaystyle\frac1{p(p+1)}=\frac A p+\frac B{p+1}$; from $1=A(p+1)+Bp$, obtain $A=1$ and $B=-1$.

steps.title: Invert term by term
steps.why: $1/p$ and $1/(p+1)$ correspond to a constant and a decaying exponential.

steps.title: Substitute into the original problem
steps.why: After inversion, both the differential equation and the initial value must be checked.

check: Substituting $t=0$ gives $y(0)=0$, so the initial value holds.
Substituting $y=1-e^{-t}$ into the left side gives the constant $1$.
As $t\to\infty$, $y(t)\to1$, matching the stable equilibrium value of the equation.

zh.question: 长度为 $l$ 的弦两端固定，满足 $u_{tt}=c^2u_{xx}$。已知 $u(x,0)=\sin(\pi x/l)$、$u_t(x,0)=0$，求 $u(x,t)$。
zh.given: 这里 $u(x,t)$ 是弦的位移，$c$ 是波速；固定端表示 $u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0$。
zh.goal: 写出满足方程、边界和两条初始条件的 $u(x,t)$。

steps.title: 选空间波形
steps.why: 两端固定时，$\sin(n\pi x/l)$ 在 $x=0,l$ 都为零，所以它自动满足边界。
steps.work: 初始位移正好是第一项 $X_1(x)=\sin(\pi x/l)$，因此只需保留 $n=1$。

steps.title: 写时间因子
steps.why: 对第 $n$ 个波形，时间因子满足 $T_n''+\omega_n^2T_n=0$，其中 $\omega_n=cn\pi/l$。

steps.title: 代初始位移
steps.why: 令 $t=0$ 可以直接确定余弦项的系数。

steps.title: 代初始速度
steps.why: 对时间求导后令 $t=0$，可以确定正弦项的系数。

check: 边界：代入 $x=0,l$，都有 $u=0$。
初值：代入 $t=0$ 得 $u(x,0)=\sin(\pi x/l)$，再求导得 $u_t(x,0)=0$。

en.question: A string of length $l$ is fixed at both ends and satisfies $u_{tt}=c^2u_{xx}$. Given $u(x,0)=\sin(\pi x/l)$ and $u_t(x,0)=0$, find $u(x,t)$.
en.given: Here $u(x,t)$ is the string displacement and $c$ is the wave speed; fixed ends mean $u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0$.
en.goal: Write the $u(x,t)$ that satisfies the equation, the boundary conditions, and both initial conditions.

steps.title: Choose the spatial mode
steps.why: For fixed ends, $\sin(n\pi x/l)$ vanishes at $x=0,l$, so it satisfies the boundary conditions automatically.
steps.work: The initial displacement is exactly the first mode $X_1(x)=\sin(\pi x/l)$, so only $n=1$ is needed.

steps.title: Write the time factor
steps.why: For mode $n$, the time factor satisfies $T_n''+\omega_n^2T_n=0$, where $\omega_n=cn\pi/l$.

steps.title: Use the displacement
steps.why: Setting $t=0$ determines the coefficient of the cosine term directly.

steps.title: Use the velocity
steps.why: Differentiate in time and then set $t=0$ to determine the sine coefficient.

check: Boundary: at $x=0,l$, one gets $u=0$.
Initial data: at $t=0$, $u(x,0)=\sin(\pi x/l)$, and differentiation gives $u_t(x,0)=0$.
Equation: $u_{tt}=-(c\pi/l)^2u$ and $u_{xx}=-(\pi/l)^2u$, so $u_{tt}=c^2u_{xx}$.

zh.question: 全轴波动方程 $u_{tt}=c^2u_{xx}$ 的初位移为 $\varphi(x)=0$，初速度为常数 $v(x)=V$。求 $u(x,t)$。
zh.given: 这里 $c>0$ 是波速，$V$ 是常数；全轴表示 $-\infty<x<\infty$，没有端点边界。
zh.goal: 用达朗贝尔公式算出 $u(x,t)$，并说明为什么结果与 $x$ 无关。

steps.title: 写出公式
steps.why: 全轴、无外力的初值问题可以直接使用达朗贝尔公式。

steps.title: 处理位移项
steps.why: 已知初位移处处为零，所以公式的前半部分消失。

steps.title: 计算速度积分
steps.why: 初速度是常数，积分就是“常数乘区间长度”。

steps.title: 得到结果
steps.why: 把积分除以公式中的 $2c$，所有与 $x$ 有关的端点项正好相消。
steps.work: $u(x,t)=\dfrac{2cVt}{2c}=Vt$；每一点具有相同初速度，所以位移不随 $x$ 改变。

check: 量纲：$Vt$ 是“速度乘时间”，量纲确实是位移。

en.question: For the full-line wave equation $u_{tt}=c^2u_{xx}$, the initial displacement is $\varphi(x)=0$ and the initial velocity is the constant $v(x)=V$. Find $u(x,t)$.
en.given: Here $c>0$ is the wave speed and $V$ is constant; the full line means $-\infty<x<\infty$, with no endpoint boundary.
en.goal: Use d'Alembert's formula to compute $u(x,t)$ and explain why the result is independent of $x$.

steps.title: Write the formula
steps.why: The full-line initial-value problem with no forcing can be solved directly by d'Alembert's formula.

steps.title: Handle displacement
steps.why: The initial displacement is zero everywhere, so the first part of the formula vanishes.

steps.title: Evaluate the velocity integral
steps.why: Because the initial velocity is constant, the integral is the constant times the interval length.

steps.title: Obtain the answer
steps.why: Divide the integral by the $2c$ in the formula; the endpoint terms involving $x$ cancel.
steps.work: $u(x,t)=\dfrac{2cVt}{2c}=Vt$; every point has the same initial velocity, so the displacement does not depend on $x$.

check: Initial data: $u(x,0)=0$ and $u_t(x,0)=V$.
Equation: $u_{tt}=0$ and $u_{xx}=0$, so $u_{tt}=c^2u_{xx}$.
Units: $Vt$ is velocity times time, so it has the units of displacement.

zh.question: 设 $\omega>0$，求零初值问题 $q''+\omega^2q=F\cos\omega t$、$q(0)=q'(0)=0$ 的解。
zh.given: 这里 $q(t)$ 是一个模态的振幅，$\omega$ 是固有角频率，$F$ 是常数外力振幅。
zh.goal: 算出共振响应 $q(t)$，并看清线性增长因子从哪里出现。

steps.title: 识别共振
steps.why: 外力 $F\cos\omega t$ 的频率与方程的固有频率 $\omega$ 相同，普通的余弦试解会与齐次解重复。
steps.work: 把试解多乘一个 $t$，令 $q_p(t)=Ct\sin\omega t$。

steps.title: 求一阶导数
steps.why: 方程含 $q''$，所以要按乘积求导法则连续求导两次。

steps.title: 求二阶导数
steps.why: 再次求导时，两处都会产生 $C\omega\cos\omega t$。

steps.title: 代回定系数
steps.why: 代回后，含 $t\sin\omega t$ 的两项会相消，只剩与外力同形的余弦项。

steps.title: 检查零初值
steps.why: 若特解已经满足零初值，就不需要再添加齐次项。

check: 代回：由上面的导数可得 $q''+\omega^2q=F\cos\omega t$。
形状：振荡仍为 $\sin\omega t$，但包络 $Ft/(2\omega)$ 随时间线性增大。

en.question: Let $\omega>0$. Solve the zero-initial-data problem $q''+\omega^2q=F\cos\omega t$ with $q(0)=q'(0)=0$.
en.given: Here $q(t)$ is one modal amplitude, $\omega$ is its natural angular frequency, and $F$ is the constant forcing amplitude.
en.goal: Compute the resonant response $q(t)$ and see exactly where the linearly growing factor comes from.

steps.title: Recognize resonance
steps.why: The forcing $F\cos\omega t$ has the same frequency as the natural frequency $\omega$, so an ordinary cosine trial duplicates a homogeneous solution.
steps.work: Multiply the trial by $t$ and set $q_p(t)=Ct\sin\omega t$.

steps.title: Differentiate once
steps.why: The equation contains $q''$, so apply the product rule twice in succession.

steps.title: Differentiate twice
steps.why: On differentiating again, two terms each produce $C\omega\cos\omega t$.

steps.title: Substitute and solve
steps.why: After substitution, the two $t\sin\omega t$ terms cancel, leaving a cosine term matching the forcing.

steps.title: Check the initial data
steps.why: If the particular solution already has zero initial data, no homogeneous correction is needed.

check: Substitution: the derivatives above give $q''+\omega^2q=F\cos\omega t$.
Initial data: $q(0)=0$ and $q'(0)=0$.
Shape: the oscillation is still $\sin\omega t$, while its envelope $Ft/(2\omega)$ grows linearly in time.

zh.question: 长度为 $l$ 的细杆满足 $u_t=\kappa u_{xx}$，两端保持零温。若 $u(x,0)=\sin(2\pi x/l)$，求 $u(x,t)$。
zh.given: 这里 $u(x,t)$ 是温度，$\kappa>0$ 是热扩散率；零温边界为 $u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0$。
zh.goal: 求温度 $u(x,t)$，并看出这个空间波形的衰减速度。

steps.title: 识别空间模态
steps.why: 零温两端对应正弦基 $\sin(n\pi x/l)$，每一项都自动满足端点条件。
steps.work: $\sin(2\pi x/l)$ 就是 $n=2$ 的模态，所以设 $u(x,t)=a_2(t)\sin(2\pi x/l)$。

steps.title: 计算空间二阶导数
steps.why: 热方程右边含 $u_{xx}$，二阶导数会给出模态的衰减系数。

steps.title: 得到时间方程
steps.why: 把 $u_t$ 和 $u_{xx}$ 代入后，可约去共同的正弦因子。

steps.title: 解衰减方程
steps.why: 方程 $a_2'=-\alpha a_2$ 的解是指数衰减，初温给出 $a_2(0)=1$。

check: 边界：代入 $x=0,l$，都有 $u=0$。
初值：代入 $t=0$，指数为 $1$，故 $u(x,0)=\sin(2\pi x/l)$。
方程：$u_t=-4\kappa\pi^2u/l^2$ 且 $u_{xx}=-4\pi^2u/l^2$，所以 $u_t=\kappa u_{xx}$。

en.question: A thin rod of length $l$ satisfies $u_t=\kappa u_{xx}$, and both ends are held at zero temperature. If $u(x,0)=\sin(2\pi x/l)$, find $u(x,t)$.
en.given: Here $u(x,t)$ is temperature and $\kappa>0$ is thermal diffusivity; the zero-temperature boundaries are $u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0$.
en.goal: Find the temperature $u(x,t)$ and identify the decay rate of this spatial mode.

steps.title: Identify the spatial mode
steps.why: Zero-temperature ends correspond to the sine basis $\sin(n\pi x/l)$, whose terms satisfy both endpoint conditions automatically.
steps.work: $\sin(2\pi x/l)$ is the mode $n=2$, so set $u(x,t)=a_2(t)\sin(2\pi x/l)$.

steps.title: Differentiate in space
steps.why: The right side of the heat equation contains $u_{xx}$, and this second derivative supplies the modal decay coefficient.

steps.title: Obtain the time equation
steps.why: After substituting $u_t$ and $u_{xx}$, cancel their common sine factor.

steps.title: Solve the decay equation
steps.why: The equation $a_2'=-\alpha a_2$ has an exponential decay solution, and the initial temperature gives $a_2(0)=1$.

check: Boundary: at $x=0,l$, one gets $u=0$.
Initial value: at $t=0$, the exponential is $1$, so $u(x,0)=\sin(2\pi x/l)$.
Equation: $u_t=-4\kappa\pi^2u/l^2$ and $u_{xx}=-4\pi^2u/l^2$, so $u_t=\kappa u_{xx}$.

zh.question: 全轴热方程 $u_t=\kappa u_{xx}$ 的初温是单位点脉冲 $u(x,0)=\delta(x)$。求 $u(x,t)$，并判断总热量是否改变。
zh.given: 这里 $\kappa>0$ 是热扩散率，$\delta(x)$ 表示总量为 $1$、集中在 $x=0$ 的点脉冲。
zh.goal: 写出热核 $u(x,t)$，算出 $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}u(x,t)\,dx$，并读出峰值和扩散尺度。

steps.title: 写出热核
steps.why: 点脉冲与热核卷积时只会抽取热核本身。

steps.title: 计算总量
steps.why: 总热量是对空间积分；用变量替换可把它化成标准高斯积分。

steps.title: 读取峰值
steps.why: 指数在 $x=0$ 时最大，所以温度峰值位于原脉冲位置。

steps.title: 读取扩散宽度
steps.why: 指数不太小时需有 $x^2/(4\kappa t)$ 约为 $1$，这给出热量主要分布的距离。
steps.work: $x^2/(4\kappa t)\sim1$ 给出 $|x|\sim2\sqrt{\kappa t}$，所以分布随时间变宽。

check: 守恒：$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}u(x,t)\,dx=1$，与单位初始总量相同。
方程：直接求导可得 $K_t=\kappa K_{xx}$。
趋势：峰值 $t^{-1/2}$ 降低而宽度 $\sqrt{t}$ 增大，两者配合保持总量不变。

en.question: For the full-line heat equation $u_t=\kappa u_{xx}$, the initial temperature is the unit point impulse $u(x,0)=\delta(x)$. Find $u(x,t)$ and decide whether the total heat changes.
en.given: Here $\kappa>0$ is thermal diffusivity, and $\delta(x)$ denotes a point impulse of total amount $1$ concentrated at $x=0$.
en.goal: Write the heat kernel $u(x,t)$, compute $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}u(x,t)\,dx$, and read off its peak and diffusion scale.

steps.title: Write the heat kernel
steps.why: Convolving a point impulse with the heat kernel returns the heat kernel itself.

steps.title: Compute the total amount
steps.why: Total heat is the spatial integral; a substitution turns it into the standard Gaussian integral.

steps.title: Read off the peak
steps.why: The exponential is largest at $x=0$, so the temperature peak remains at the original impulse location.
steps.work: $K(0,t)=1/\sqrt{4\pi\kappa t}$, so the peak falls like $t^{-1/2}$.

steps.title: Read off the width
steps.why: For a non-negligible exponential, $x^2/(4\kappa t)$ must be about $1$, which gives the main spreading distance.
steps.work: $x^2/(4\kappa t)\sim1$ gives $|x|\sim2\sqrt{\kappa t}$, so the distribution widens with time.

check: Conservation: $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}u(x,t)\,dx=1$, equal to the unit initial amount.
Equation: direct differentiation gives $K_t=\kappa K_{xx}$.
Trend: the peak falls like $t^{-1/2}$ while the width grows like $\sqrt{t}$, and together they preserve the total amount.

zh.question: 细杆 $0<x<L$ 满足 $u_t=\kappa u_{xx}$，端点温度为 $u(0,t)=0$、$u(L,t)=T$，初温 $u(x,0)=0$。求 $u(x,t)$ 及其稳态。
zh.given: 这里 $T$ 是常数端点温度，$\kappa>0$ 是热扩散率；初始角点 $(L,0)$ 的数据不相容，初值按杆内部理解。
zh.goal: 先把非齐次边界变成零边界，再求 $u(x,t)$ 并取 $t\to\infty$。

steps.title: 选边界函数
steps.why: 先找一个简单函数单独承担两端温度，剩余未知量就能使用正弦展开。

steps.title: 换成零边界
steps.why: 令 $v=u-h$ 后，$h$ 吸收了非零端点值。

steps.title: 投影初值
steps.why: 零边界使用 $\sin(n\pi x/L)$；系数由正交积分给出。

steps.title: 算清积分
steps.why: 分部积分能把 $I_n$ 化成端点值，避免跳过符号。

steps.title: 组合并取极限
steps.why: 每个正弦模态按自己的热方程因子衰减，最后只留下边界函数。

check: 边界：正弦项在 $x=0,L$ 为零，所以 $u(0,t)=0$、$u(L,t)=T$。
方程：$Tx/L$ 的二阶导数为零，每个级数项都满足 $u_t=\kappa u_{xx}$。
稳态：当 $t\to\infty$ 时所有指数项趋于零，只剩 $Tx/L$。

en.question: A thin rod on $0<x<L$ satisfies $u_t=\kappa u_{xx}$, with endpoint temperatures $u(0,t)=0$ and $u(L,t)=T$, and initial temperature $u(x,0)=0$. Find $u(x,t)$ and its steady state.
en.given: Here $T$ is the constant endpoint temperature and $\kappa>0$ is thermal diffusivity; the data conflict at the initial corner $(L,0)$, so interpret the initial value inside the rod.
en.goal: First turn the nonhomogeneous boundary into zero boundary data, then find $u(x,t)$ and take $t\to\infty$.

steps.title: Choose a boundary function
steps.why: First find a simple function that carries both endpoint temperatures, so the remaining unknown can use a sine expansion.

steps.title: Create zero boundaries
steps.why: After setting $v=u-h$, the function $h$ absorbs the nonzero endpoint value.

steps.title: Project the initial value
steps.why: Zero boundary data use $\sin(n\pi x/L)$, and orthogonality gives each coefficient.

steps.title: Evaluate the integral
steps.why: Integration by parts reduces $I_n$ to endpoint values and makes the sign explicit.

steps.title: Combine and take the limit
steps.why: Each sine mode decays by its heat-equation factor, so only the boundary function remains at long times.

check: Boundary: every sine term vanishes at $x=0,L$, so $u(0,t)=0$ and $u(L,t)=T$.
Equation: the second derivative of $Tx/L$ is zero, and every series term satisfies $u_t=\kappa u_{xx}$.
Steady state: as $t\to\infty$, all exponential terms vanish, leaving $Tx/L$.

zh.question: 在矩形 $0<x<a$、$0<y<b$ 内解 $u_{xx}+u_{yy}=0$。边界为 $u(0,y)=u(a,y)=u(x,0)=0$，$u(x,b)=\sin(\pi x/a)$。
zh.given: 这里 $u(x,y)$ 是稳定场；三条边为零，只有顶边给出一个正弦分布。
zh.goal: 用分离变量求出 $u(x,y)$，并逐边检查四个边界条件。

steps.title: 分离变量
steps.why: 矩形边界与乘积形状相配，设 $u=X(x)Y(y)$ 可把偏微分方程拆成两个常微分方程。

steps.title: 满足左右边
steps.why: $X(0)=X(a)=0$ 选出正弦本征函数和离散波数。

steps.title: 满足底边
steps.why: $Y(0)=0$ 要去掉双曲余弦，只留下在零点为零的双曲正弦。

steps.title: 匹配顶边
steps.why: 顶边数据本身就是 $n=1$ 的正弦，所以其他模态系数全为零。

check: 方程：令 $k=\pi/a$，则 $u_{xx}=-k^2u$、$u_{yy}=k^2u$，两者相加为零。
三条零边：在 $x=0,a$ 时正弦为零，在 $y=0$ 时 $\sinh(0)=0$。
顶边：令 $y=b$，分子分母相同，得到 $u(x,b)=\sin(\pi x/a)$。

en.question: In the rectangle $0<x<a$, $0<y<b$, solve $u_{xx}+u_{yy}=0$. The boundaries are $u(0,y)=u(a,y)=u(x,0)=0$ and $u(x,b)=\sin(\pi x/a)$.
en.given: Here $u(x,y)$ is a steady field; three sides are zero, and only the top side has a sine profile.
en.goal: Use separation of variables to find $u(x,y)$ and check all four boundary conditions one by one.

steps.title: Separate variables
steps.why: The rectangular boundaries fit a product form, so setting $u=X(x)Y(y)$ splits the partial differential equation into two ordinary differential equations.

steps.title: Satisfy the side boundaries
steps.why: $X(0)=X(a)=0$ selects sine eigenfunctions and discrete wave numbers.

steps.title: Satisfy the bottom boundary
steps.why: $Y(0)=0$ removes the hyperbolic cosine and leaves the hyperbolic sine, which vanishes at zero.
steps.work: $Y_n(y)=C_n\sinh(k_ny)$; after normalization at the top, write $Y_n(y)=\sinh(k_ny)/\sinh(k_nb)$.

steps.title: Match the top boundary
steps.why: The top data is already the sine mode $n=1$, so every other modal coefficient is zero.
steps.work: With $k_1=\pi/a$, one gets $u(x,y)=\sin(\pi x/a)\dfrac{\sinh(\pi y/a)}{\sinh(\pi b/a)}$.

check: Equation: let $k=\pi/a$; then $u_{xx}=-k^2u$ and $u_{yy}=k^2u$, so their sum is zero.
Three zero sides: the sine vanishes at $x=0,a$; at $y=0$, one has $\sinh(0)=0$.
Top side: setting $y=b$ makes numerator and denominator equal, giving $u(x,b)=\sin(\pi x/a)$.

zh.question: 球域 $\Omega$ 内没有热源，故 $\Delta u=0$；球面 $\partial\Omega$ 上温度恒为 $u=5$。球心温度能否高于 $5$？
zh.given: 这里 $u$ 是稳定温度，$\Delta$ 是拉普拉斯算子；边界上每一点都给出同一个数值。
zh.goal: 先找到一个解，再用唯一性或最大值原理判断球内全部温度。

steps.title: 先试常数解
steps.why: 边界值是常数，最简单的候选就是把这个常数延伸到整个球内。
steps.work: 令 $u_*(x)=5$，则 $\Delta u_*=0$，并且在 $\partial\Omega$ 上有 $u_*=5$。

steps.title: 构造解的差
steps.why: 要证明没有别的解，把任意解与已知解相减就得到零边界问题。

steps.title: 使用能量恒等式
steps.why: 零边界会让分部积分的边界项消失，从而控制梯度。

steps.title: 得出唯一解
steps.why: 非负函数 $|\nabla w|^2$ 的积分为零，只能有 $\nabla w=0$；再用零边界确定常数。
steps.work: $w=0$，所以 $u(x)=5$ 在整个 $\Omega$ 内成立，球心也只能是 $5$。

check: 代回：常函数 $u=5$ 的所有二阶导数为零，所以 $\Delta u=0$。
边界：在 $\partial\Omega$ 上仍有 $u=5$。
最大值原理：$\max_\Omega u\le5$ 且 $\min_\Omega u\ge5$，与 $u=5$ 一致。

en.question: There is no heat source in the ball $\Omega$, so $\Delta u=0$; the temperature on the sphere $\partial\Omega$ is the constant $u=5$. Can the center temperature exceed $5$?
en.given: Here $u$ is steady temperature and $\Delta$ is the Laplacian; every point of the boundary is assigned the same value.
en.goal: First find one solution, then use uniqueness or the maximum principle to determine the temperature everywhere inside the ball.

steps.title: Try a constant solution
steps.why: Because the boundary value is constant, the simplest candidate extends that constant throughout the ball.
steps.work: Set $u_*(x)=5$; then $\Delta u_*=0$, and on $\partial\Omega$ one has $u_*=5$.

steps.title: Form the difference
steps.why: To rule out another solution, subtract the known solution from any solution and obtain a zero-boundary problem.
steps.work: Let $w=u-u_*$; then $\Delta w=0$, and on $\partial\Omega$ one has $w=0$.

steps.title: Use the energy identity
steps.why: The zero boundary makes the boundary term from integration by parts vanish, which controls the gradient.

steps.title: Conclude uniqueness
steps.why: The nonnegative function $|\nabla w|^2$ has zero integral, so $\nabla w=0$; the zero boundary then fixes the constant.
steps.work: $w=0$, so $u(x)=5$ throughout $\Omega$, and the center value is $5$.

check: Substitution: every second derivative of the constant function $u=5$ is zero, so $\Delta u=0$.
Boundary: on $\partial\Omega$, one still has $u=5$.
Maximum principle: $\max_\Omega u\le5$ and $\min_\Omega u\ge5$, consistent with $u=5$.

zh.question: 在 $x>0$ 上，把 $xy''+(1-x)y'+ay=0$ 写成施图姆–刘维尔自伴形式。
zh.given: 目标标准形为 $(py')'+(\lambda w-q)y=0$；其中 $p$ 是导数项系数，$w$ 是权函数。
zh.goal: 找出乘子，并明确写出 $p(x)$、$q(x)$、$w(x)$ 和 $\lambda$。

steps.title: 观察总导数
steps.why: 要把前两项合成 $(py')'$，$y''$ 的系数和 $y'$ 的系数必须分别是 $p$ 和 $p'$。
steps.work: 因为 $(xe^{-x})'=(1-x)e^{-x}$，乘上 $e^{-x}$ 后正好出现所需的一对系数。

steps.title: 乘上因子
steps.why: 对原方程每一项都乘 $e^{-x}$，解集不变，因为 $e^{-x}>0$。

steps.title: 合并导数项
steps.why: 乘积求导公式给出 $(xe^{-x}y')'=xe^{-x}y''+(1-x)e^{-x}y'$。

steps.title: 对照标准形
steps.why: 把参数 $a$ 放在 $\lambda w$ 的位置，就能逐项读出四个量。

check: 展开：$(xe^{-x}y')'=xe^{-x}y''+(1-x)e^{-x}y'$，与乘因子后的前两项相同。
除回：自伴方程除以 $e^{-x}$ 后恢复 $xy''+(1-x)y'+ay=0$。

en.question: On $x>0$, put $xy''+(1-x)y'+ay=0$ into Sturm–Liouville self-adjoint form.
en.given: The target standard form is $(py')'+(\lambda w-q)y=0$; here $p$ is the derivative coefficient and $w$ is the weight function.
en.goal: Find the multiplier and state $p(x)$, $q(x)$, $w(x)$, and $\lambda$ explicitly.

steps.title: Look for a total derivative
steps.why: To combine the first two terms into $(py')'$, the coefficients of $y''$ and $y'$ must be $p$ and $p'$, respectively.
steps.work: Because $(xe^{-x})'=(1-x)e^{-x}$, multiplication by $e^{-x}$ creates exactly the required pair of coefficients.

steps.title: Apply the multiplier
steps.why: Multiply every term by $e^{-x}$; the solution set is unchanged because $e^{-x}>0$.

steps.title: Combine derivative terms
steps.why: The product rule gives $(xe^{-x}y')'=xe^{-x}y''+(1-x)e^{-x}y'$.

steps.title: Match the standard form
steps.why: Place the parameter $a$ in the position of $\lambda w$, and then read off all four quantities.

check: Expansion: $(xe^{-x}y')'=xe^{-x}y''+(1-x)e^{-x}y'$, matching the first two multiplied terms.
Divide back: dividing the self-adjoint equation by $e^{-x}$ recovers $xy''+(1-x)y'+ay=0$.
Positivity: on $x>0$, $p(x)=xe^{-x}>0$ and $w(x)=e^{-x}>0$.

zh.question: 判断 $y_1=e^x$、$y_2=e^{-x}$ 能否组成方程 $y''-y=0$ 的基本解组，并写出通解。
zh.given: 基本解组需要同时满足两件事：每个函数都是方程的解，而且两者线性无关。
zh.goal: 通过代回和朗斯基行列式 $W$ 完成判断，再写出所有解。

steps.title: 先验算两个解
steps.why: 朗斯基只检验函数是否独立，不能代替“它们确实满足方程”的检查。

steps.title: 列出一阶导数
steps.why: 二阶方程的朗斯基由函数及其一阶导数组成。

steps.title: 计算朗斯基
steps.why: 只要某点有 $W\ne0$，两个解就在整个区间上线性无关。

steps.title: 写出通解
steps.why: 二阶齐次线性方程有两个独立解时，它们的线性组合给出全部解。
steps.work: 因为 $W=-2\ne0$，基本解组成立，通解为 $y=C_1e^x+C_2e^{-x}$。

check: 代回：$e^x$ 和 $e^{-x}$ 分别满足 $y''-y=0$。
独立性：$W=-2$ 处处非零。
阿贝尔公式：本题标准式的 $P(x)=0$，所以 $W'= -P(x)W=0$，与常数朗斯基一致。

en.question: Decide whether $y_1=e^x$ and $y_2=e^{-x}$ form a fundamental solution set for $y''-y=0$, and write the general solution.
en.given: A fundamental solution set must meet two conditions: each function solves the equation, and the two functions are linearly independent.
en.goal: Use substitution and the Wronskian $W$ to decide, then write every solution.

steps.title: Verify both solutions
steps.why: The Wronskian tests independence only; it does not replace checking that the functions solve the equation.

steps.title: List first derivatives
steps.why: For a second-order equation, the Wronskian uses the functions and their first derivatives.

steps.title: Compute the Wronskian
steps.why: If $W\ne0$ at one point, the two solutions are linearly independent throughout the interval.

steps.title: Write the general solution
steps.why: When a second-order homogeneous linear equation has two independent solutions, their linear combinations give all solutions.
steps.work: Because $W=-2\ne0$, the set is fundamental and the general solution is $y=C_1e^x+C_2e^{-x}$.

check: Substitution: both $e^x$ and $e^{-x}$ satisfy $y''-y=0$.
Independence: $W=-2$ is nonzero everywhere.
Abel's formula: the standard equation has $P(x)=0$, so $W'= -P(x)W=0$, consistent with a constant Wronskian.

zh.question: 在 $x>0$ 上求欧拉方程 $x^2y''+xy'-\nu^2y=0$ 的指标根和通解，其中 $\nu\ge0$。
zh.given: 这是正则奇点型方程；幂函数试解 $y=x^r$ 会把微分方程变成关于 $r$ 的代数方程。
zh.goal: 分别处理 $\nu>0$ 和重根 $\nu=0$，写出完整通解。

steps.title: 代入幂函数
steps.why: 欧拉方程中每项含相同的总幂次，所以 $y=x^r$ 能把 $x$ 因子统一。

steps.title: 求指标根
steps.why: 代入后提取非零因子 $x^r$，其系数必须为零。

steps.title: 处理不同根
steps.why: 当 $\nu>0$ 时两根不同，对应两个候选解。

steps.title: 写不同根通解
steps.why: 朗斯基非零说明两个解独立，可以组成二阶方程的基本解组。

steps.title: 处理重根
steps.why: 当 $\nu=0$ 时两根重合，只保留 $1$ 不够，需要直接积分寻找第二解。
steps.work: 方程变为 $(xy')'=0$，所以 $xy'=C_2$，再积分得 $y=C_1+C_2\ln x$。

en.question: On $x>0$, find the indicial roots and general solution of the Euler equation $x^2y''+xy'-\nu^2y=0$, where $\nu\ge0$.
en.given: This is a regular-singular-type equation; the power trial $y=x^r$ changes the differential equation into an algebraic equation for $r$.
en.goal: Treat $\nu>0$ and the repeated-root case $\nu=0$ separately, and write the complete general solution.

steps.title: Substitute a power
steps.why: Every term in an Euler equation has the same total power, so $y=x^r$ aligns all powers of $x$.

steps.title: Find the indicial roots
steps.why: After substitution, factor out the nonzero factor $x^r$; its coefficient must vanish.

steps.title: Handle distinct roots
steps.why: When $\nu>0$, the roots are distinct and give two candidate solutions.

steps.title: Write the distinct-root solution
steps.why: The nonzero Wronskian shows that the two solutions are independent and form a fundamental set for the second-order equation.

steps.title: Handle the repeated root
steps.why: When $\nu=0$, the roots coincide; retaining only $1$ is insufficient, so integrate directly to find the second solution.
steps.work: The equation becomes $(xy')'=0$, so $xy'=C_2$, and another integration gives $y=C_1+C_2\ln x$.

check:

u$ or $x^{-
u}$ gives $(r^2-
