u>0$, $W=-2
u/x
e0$.
Repeated root: $y=\ln x$ has $y'=1/x$ and $y''=-1/x^2$, which gives $x^2y''+xy'=0$.

zh.question: 用常数变易法求非齐次方程 $y''+y=1$ 的通解。
zh.given: 先解对应齐次方程，再把常数系数改为函数；本题右端为 $f(x)=1$。
zh.goal: 算出一个特解 $y_p$，再与齐次通解相加。

steps.title: 求齐次基本解
steps.why: 常数变易法从对应齐次方程的两个独立解开始。
steps.work: $y''+y=0$ 的基本解可取 $y_1=\cos x$、$y_2=\sin x$。

steps.title: 计算朗斯基
steps.why: 变易公式的分母是 $W$，先算清它可避免后面漏掉符号。

steps.title: 组成特解
steps.why: 把变化系数乘回对应基本解，得到一个非齐次特解。

steps.title: 写出通解
steps.why: 非齐次方程的全部解等于一个特解加齐次方程的全部解。

check: 齐次项：$C_1\cos x+C_2\sin x$ 代入 $y''+y$ 后为零。
合并：因此任意 $C_1,C_2$ 都满足原方程 $y''+y=1$。

en.question: Use variation of parameters to find the general solution of $y''+y=1$.
en.given: First solve the corresponding homogeneous equation, then replace its constant coefficients by functions; here the right side is $f(x)=1$.
en.goal: Compute one particular solution $y_p$, then add it to the homogeneous general solution.

steps.title: Find homogeneous solutions
steps.why: Variation of parameters begins with two independent solutions of the corresponding homogeneous equation.
steps.work: A fundamental set for $y''+y=0$ is $y_1=\cos x$ and $y_2=\sin x$.

steps.title: Compute the Wronskian
steps.why: The denominator in the variation formulas is $W$, so computing it first prevents a later sign error.

steps.title: Find the varying coefficients
steps.why: For the standard form $y''+P y'+Qy=f$, one has $u_1'=-y_2f/W$ and $u_2'=y_1f/W$.
steps.work: $u_1'=-\sin x$ and $u_2'=\cos x$, so choose $u_1=\cos x$ and $u_2=\sin x$.

steps.title: Build a particular solution
steps.why: Multiply each varying coefficient by its matching fundamental solution to obtain a particular solution.

steps.title: Write the general solution
steps.why: Every solution of the nonhomogeneous equation is one particular solution plus every homogeneous solution.

check: Particular term: $y_p=1$ gives $y_p''+y_p=0+1=1$.
Homogeneous terms: substituting $C_1\cos x+C_2\sin x$ into $y''+y$ gives zero.
Combination: therefore every $C_1,C_2$ satisfies the original equation $y''+y=1$.

zh.question: 由拉梅系数一步步推出柱坐标中的拉普拉斯算符。
zh.given: 柱坐标为 $(\rho,\phi,z)$，位置矢量满足 $d\mathbf r=\mathbf e_\rho d\rho+\mathbf e_\phi\rho\,d\phi+\mathbf e_zdz$。正交坐标的通式为 $\nabla^2u=\frac1{h_1h_2h_3}\sum_i\partial_{q_i}[(h_1h_2h_3/h_i^2)\partial_{q_i}u]$。
zh.goal: 求出 $\nabla^2u$ 在 $(\rho,\phi,z)$ 中的具体形式。

steps.title: 读出长度因子
steps.why: 拉梅系数表示坐标增加一单位时，实际长度增加多少。
steps.work: 由三个实际小长度 $d\rho,\rho\,d\phi,dz$ 得 $h_\rho=1$、$h_\phi=\rho$、$h_z=1$，所以 $h_\rho h_\phi h_z=\rho$。

steps.title: 代入径向项
steps.why: 先逐项代入，可以避免把三个尺度因子混在一起。
steps.work: 径向括号中的系数是 $\rho/h_\rho^2=\rho$，因此这一项为 $\rho^{-1}\partial_\rho(\rho\,\partial_\rho u)$。

steps.title: 代入角向项
steps.why: 角向实际长度含有 $\rho$，这里最容易漏掉一个平方。
steps.work: 角向系数是 $\rho/h_\phi^2=1/\rho$，故角向项为 $\rho^{-1}\partial_\phi(\rho^{-1}\partial_\phi u)=\rho^{-2}\partial_\phi^2u$。

steps.title: 代入轴向项
steps.why: 轴向尺度因子为常数，所以它应退化成熟悉的二阶导数。
steps.work: 轴向系数是 $\rho/h_z^2=\rho$，故轴向项为 $\rho^{-1}\partial_z(\rho\,\partial_zu)=\partial_z^2u$。

steps.title: 合并三项
steps.why: 拉普拉斯算符就是三个正交方向贡献的和。

check: 取 $u=\rho^2$，公式给 $\rho^{-1}\partial_\rho(2\rho^2)=4$，与 $u=x^2+y^2$ 的直角坐标结果一致。
若 $u$ 只依赖 $z$，公式只剩 $\partial_z^2u$，符合一维情形。
角向项前应为 $1/\rho^2$；若只有 $1/\rho$，量纲就不是 $u/$长度$^2$。

en.question: Derive the cylindrical-coordinate Laplacian from the scale factors, one step at a time.
en.given: The coordinates are $(\rho,\phi,z)$, with $d\mathbf r=\mathbf e_\rho d\rho+\mathbf e_\phi\rho\,d\phi+\mathbf e_zdz$. For orthogonal coordinates, $\nabla^2u=\frac1{h_1h_2h_3}\sum_i\partial_{q_i}[(h_1h_2h_3/h_i^2)\partial_{q_i}u]$.
en.goal: Find the explicit form of $\nabla^2u$ in $(\rho,\phi,z)$.

steps.title: Read the scale factors
steps.why: A scale factor tells us the physical length produced by one coordinate increment.
steps.work: The three physical increments $d\rho,\rho\,d\phi,dz$ give $h_\rho=1$, $h_\phi=\rho$, and $h_z=1$, so $h_\rho h_\phi h_z=\rho$.

steps.title: Substitute the radial term
steps.why: Substituting one direction at a time prevents the three factors from being mixed up.
steps.work: The radial bracket coefficient is $\rho/h_\rho^2=\rho$, so this term is $\rho^{-1}\partial_\rho(\rho\,\partial_\rho u)$.

steps.title: Substitute the angular term
steps.why: The angular physical length contains $\rho$, so a missing square is common here.
steps.work: The angular coefficient is $\rho/h_\phi^2=1/\rho$, hence the term is $\rho^{-1}\partial_\phi(\rho^{-1}\partial_\phi u)=\rho^{-2}\partial_\phi^2u$.

steps.title: Substitute the axial term
steps.why: The axial scale factor is constant, so this part should reduce to an ordinary second derivative.
steps.work: The axial coefficient is $\rho/h_z^2=\rho$, hence the term is $\rho^{-1}\partial_z(\rho\,\partial_zu)=\partial_z^2u$.

steps.title: Combine the terms
steps.why: The Laplacian is the sum of the three orthogonal-direction contributions.

check: For $u=\rho^2$, the formula gives $\rho^{-1}\partial_\rho(2\rho^2)=4$, matching the Cartesian result for $u=x^2+y^2$.
If $u$ depends only on $z$, only $\partial_z^2u$ remains, as in the one-dimensional case.
The angular coefficient must be $1/\rho^2$; with only $1/\rho$, the units would not be $u/$length$^2$.

zh.question: 半径为 $R$ 的球面温度是 $2+3\cos\theta$，求球内的稳态温度。
zh.given: 球内无热源，所以 $\nabla^2u=0$；温度与方位角无关。球面边界为 $u(R,\theta)=2+3\cos\theta$。
zh.goal: 求在 $0\le r\le R$ 内有限的 $u(r,\theta)$。

steps.title: 拆成角向模态
steps.why: 球内 Laplace 方程的轴对称角函数是 Legendre 多项式。

steps.title: 选择径向解
steps.why: 第 $l$ 阶有 $r^l$ 和 $r^{-l-1}$ 两支；球心有限要求删掉负幂。
steps.work: 保留 $l=0$ 的常数径向因子和 $l=1$ 的 $r$；为使球面上的因子等于 $1$，分别取 $1$ 和 $r/R$。

steps.title: 沿用边界系数
steps.why: 径向因子在 $r=R$ 时都等于 $1$，所以边界展开系数不需要再改变。
steps.work: 零阶贡献为 $2\cdot1\cdot P_0=2$，一阶贡献为 $3(r/R)P_1=3(r/R)\cos\theta$。

steps.title: 写出答案
steps.why: 把两个非零模态相加即可得到满足同一线性方程的解。

check: 代入 $r=R$ 得 $u(R,\theta)=2+3\cos\theta$，边界完全恢复。
利用 $r\cos\theta=z$，可写成 $u=2+3z/R$，它的所有二阶偏导之和为零。
在 $r=0$ 时 $u=2$，没有出现 $1/r$ 型发散。

en.question: A sphere of radius $R$ has surface temperature $2+3\cos\theta$. Find the steady temperature inside.
en.given: There is no heat source inside, so $\nabla^2u=0$, and the temperature is independent of azimuth. The boundary condition is $u(R,\theta)=2+3\cos\theta$.
en.goal: For $0\le r\le R$, find the finite solution $u(r,\theta)$.

steps.title: Split angular modes
steps.why: The axisymmetric angular functions for the Laplace equation in a ball are Legendre polynomials.
steps.work: Since $P_0(\cos\theta)=1$ and $P_1(\cos\theta)=\cos\theta$, write the boundary data as $2P_0(\cos\theta)+3P_1(\cos\theta)$.

steps.title: Choose radial solutions
steps.why: Order $l$ has branches $r^l$ and $r^{-l-1}$; finiteness at the center removes the negative power.
steps.work: For $l=0$, keep the constant factor; for $l=1$, keep $r$. Normalize them to equal $1$ on the sphere by using $1$ and $r/R$.

steps.title: Keep boundary coefficients
steps.why: At $r=R$, both radial factors equal $1$, so the boundary expansion coefficients stay unchanged.
steps.work: The order-zero contribution is $2\cdot1\cdot P_0=2$, and the order-one contribution is $3(r/R)P_1=3(r/R)\cos\theta$.

steps.title: Write the answer
steps.why: Adding the two nonzero modes gives another solution of the same linear equation.

check: Setting $r=R$ gives $u(R,\theta)=2+3\cos\theta$, exactly reproducing the boundary data.
Using $r\cos\theta=z$, write $u=2+3z/R$; the sum of its second derivatives is zero.
At $r=0$, $u=2$, so no $1/r$ singularity appears.

zh.question: 把常数函数 $1$ 展开为圆柱零侧边界的径向本征函数。
zh.given: $j_{0n}$ 是 $J_0$ 的第 $n$ 个正零点，本征函数为 $J_0(j_{0n}\rho/a)$。其带权范数为 $\int_0^a\rho J_0(j_{0n}\rho/a)^2d\rho=a^2J_1(j_{0n})^2/2$。
zh.goal: 在 $1=\sum_{n\ge1}c_nJ_0(j_{0n}\rho/a)$ 中求 $c_n$。

steps.title: 做带权投影
steps.why: 圆柱径向本征函数的正交权是 $\rho$，普通积分会给错系数。
steps.work: 两边乘 $\rho J_0(j_{0m}\rho/a)$ 并从 $0$ 积到 $a$，正交性给 $c_m=\frac{\int_0^a\rho J_0(j_{0m}\rho/a)d\rho}{a^2J_1(j_{0m})^2/2}$。

steps.title: 换成无量纲变量
steps.why: 令变量进入标准 Bessel 恒等式，积分会立刻变成一个边界值。
steps.work: 记 $j=j_{0m}$ 并令 $x=j\rho/a$，则 $\rho d\rho=a^2x dx/j^2$，所以分子为 $\frac{a^2}{j^2}\int_0^j xJ_0(x)dx$。

steps.title: 算出分子
steps.why: 恒等式 $(xJ_1(x))'=xJ_0(x)$ 直接给出原函数。

steps.title: 除以范数
steps.why: 投影系数等于该模态的内积除以该模态自身的内积。

steps.title: 说明边界点
steps.why: 所有基函数在侧壁都为零，而被展开的常数在侧壁等于一。
steps.work: 级数在 $0\le\rho<a$ 的内部恢复 $1$；在 $\rho=a$，每一项都含 $J_0(j_{0n})=0$，所以端点值为 $0$。

check: $a^2$ 在分子和范数中相消，因此 $c_n$ 无量纲，符合常数函数的展开。
把 $c_n$ 代回投影式，右边变成 $[2/(jJ_1(j))][a^2J_1(j)^2/2]=a^2J_1(j)/j$，正好等于分子。
不要用无权正交；本题积分中必须保留 $\rho d\rho$。

en.question: Expand the constant function $1$ in the radial eigenfunctions for a cylindrical zero side boundary.
en.given: $j_{0n}$ is a positive zero of $J_0$, with index $n$, and the eigenfunction is $J_0(j_{0n}\rho/a)$. Its weighted norm is $\int_0^a\rho J_0(j_{0n}\rho/a)^2d\rho=a^2J_1(j_{0n})^2/2$.
en.goal: In $1=\sum_{n\ge1}c_nJ_0(j_{0n}\rho/a)$, find $c_n$.

steps.title: Take a weighted projection
steps.why: The cylindrical radial eigenfunctions use weight $\rho$; an unweighted integral gives the wrong coefficient.
steps.work: Multiply by $\rho J_0(j_{0m}\rho/a)$ and integrate from $0$ to $a$. Orthogonality gives $c_m=\frac{\int_0^a\rho J_0(j_{0m}\rho/a)d\rho}{a^2J_1(j_{0m})^2/2}$.

steps.title: Use a dimensionless variable
steps.why: Putting the variable into a standard Bessel identity turns the integral into a boundary value.
steps.work: Set $j=j_{0m}$ and $x=j\rho/a$. Then $\rho d\rho=a^2x dx/j^2$, so the numerator is $\frac{a^2}{j^2}\int_0^j xJ_0(x)dx$.

steps.title: Evaluate the numerator
steps.why: The identity $(xJ_1(x))'=xJ_0(x)$ supplies the antiderivative directly.

steps.title: Divide by the norm
steps.why: A projection coefficient is the inner product with the mode divided by the mode's squared norm.

steps.title: Explain the boundary point
steps.why: Every basis function vanishes on the side wall, while the expanded constant equals one there.
steps.work: In the interior $0\le\rho<a$, the series recovers $1$. At $\rho=a$, every term contains $J_0(j_{0n})=0$, so its endpoint value is $0$.

check: The factors $a^2$ cancel between numerator and norm, so $c_n$ is dimensionless, as required for expanding a constant.
Substituting $c_n$ into the projection gives $[2/(jJ_1(j))][a^2J_1(j)^2/2]=a^2J_1(j)/j$, exactly the numerator.
Do not use unweighted orthogonality; the measure must contain $\rho d\rho$.

zh.question: 半径为 $R$ 的球面保持零温，球对称温度的最慢衰减时间是多少？
zh.given: 球内热方程为 $u_t=D\nabla^2u$，其中 $D>0$ 是热扩散率。球面满足 $u(R,t)=0$，并只考虑球对称模态。
zh.goal: 找出最小正本征值 $k_1$，再求时间尺度 $\tau$。

steps.title: 写球对称径向解
steps.why: 球对称对应角阶 $l=0$，球心有限的 Helmholtz 径向解只有球 Bessel 函数。
steps.work: $X(r)=j_0(kr)=\frac{\sin(kr)}{kr}$；当 $r\to0$ 时，$\sin(kr)/(kr)\to1$，所以它在球心有限。

steps.title: 使用球面边界
steps.why: 齐次边界只允许使径向函数在 $r=R$ 为零的离散波数。

steps.title: 选择最慢模态
steps.why: 热模态按 $e^{-Dk_n^2t}$ 衰减，$k_n$ 越小，衰减越慢。
steps.work: 最小正波数为 $k_1=\pi/R$，对应时间因子 $e^{-D\pi^2t/R^2}$。

steps.title: 读出时间尺度
steps.why: 把指数写成标准形式 $e^{-t/\tau}$，就能直接读出特征时间。

check: $D$ 的单位是长度$^2/$时间，所以 $R^2/D$ 的单位确实是时间。
在 $t=\tau$ 时，最慢模态变为 $e^{-1}$ 倍，符合时间尺度的定义。
若把 $R$ 加倍而 $D$ 不变，$\tau$ 变为四倍，符合扩散距离平方律。

en.question: A sphere of radius $R$ is held at zero surface temperature. What is the slowest decay time for a spherically symmetric temperature?
en.given: Inside the sphere, $u_t=D\nabla^2u$, where $D>0$ is the thermal diffusivity. The boundary condition is $u(R,t)=0$, and only spherically symmetric modes are considered.
en.goal: Find the smallest positive eigenvalue $k_1$, then obtain the time scale $\tau$.

steps.title: Write the radial solution
steps.why: Spherical symmetry means angular order $l=0$, whose center-finite Helmholtz radial solution is a spherical Bessel function.
steps.work: $X(r)=j_0(kr)=\frac{\sin(kr)}{kr}$. As $r\to0$, $\sin(kr)/(kr)\to1$, so it stays finite at the center.

steps.title: Apply the surface boundary
steps.why: The homogeneous boundary permits only discrete wave numbers for which the radial function vanishes at $r=R$.

steps.title: Choose the slowest mode
steps.why: A heat mode decays as $e^{-Dk_n^2t}$, so the smallest $k_n$ decays most slowly.
steps.work: The smallest positive wave number is $k_1=\pi/R$, giving the time factor $e^{-D\pi^2t/R^2}$.

steps.title: Read the time scale
steps.why: Writing the exponential in the standard form $e^{-t/\tau}$ makes the characteristic time explicit.

check: $D$ has units length$^2/$time, so $R^2/D$ indeed has units of time.
At $t=\tau$, the slowest mode is multiplied by $e^{-1}$, matching the definition of the time scale.
If $R$ doubles while $D$ stays fixed, $\tau$ becomes four times larger, as expected from diffusion's distance-squared scaling.

zh.question: 一端为尖端的自由楔杆满足 $A(x)\propto x$，哪些零点决定它的正频率？
zh.given: 杆占据 $0\le x\le l$，尖端在 $x=0$，粗端 $x=l$ 也无外力。分离后的空间方程为 $(AX')'+k^2AX=0$，频率满足 $\omega=ck$。
zh.goal: 求允许的正波数 $k_n$ 和正频率 $\omega_n$。

steps.title: 代入截面积
steps.why: 截面积的幂次决定空间方程属于哪一种 Bessel 方程。

steps.title: 选择尖端有限解
steps.why: 这个方程的两支解是 $J_0(kx)$ 和 $Y_0(kx)$，但物理位移不能在尖端发散。
steps.work: $Y_0(kx)$ 在 $x\to0$ 时发散，因此取 $X(x)=C J_0(kx)$。

steps.title: 写自由端条件
steps.why: 自由端的轴向力 $EA(l)X'(l)$ 为零；因 $A(l)\ne0$，这等价于导数为零。

steps.title: 求正频率
steps.why: 对正频率有 $k>0$，因此不能用 $k=0$ 来满足上一步。

steps.title: 单独处理零模态
steps.why: 除以 $k$ 会遗漏 $k=0$，所以它必须回到原方程检查。
steps.work: $k=0$ 时 $(xX')'=0$，有限解是 $X=$常数，表示整根杆刚体平移而不是正频振动。

check: $cj_{1n}/l$ 的单位是 $1/$时间，因为 $j_{1n}$ 无量纲且 $c/l$ 是频率。
代入 $x=l$ 得 $X'(l)=-C(j_{1n}/l)J_1(j_{1n})=0$，自由边界满足。
不能保留 $Y_0$；它在 $x=0$ 发散，不符合尖端有限性。

en.question: A free wedge rod has a pointed end and $A(x)\propto x$. Which zeros determine its positive frequencies?
en.given: The rod occupies $0\le x\le l$, with the tip at $x=0$ and no external force at the thick end $x=l$. The separated spatial equation is $(AX')'+k^2AX=0$, and $\omega=ck$.
en.goal: Find the allowed positive wave numbers $k_n$ and frequencies $\omega_n$.

steps.title: Substitute the area
steps.why: The power of the cross-sectional area determines the type of Bessel equation.
steps.work: Take $A(x)=A_0x/l$. Expanding $(AX')'+k^2AX=0$ and dividing by $A$ gives $X''+x^{-1}X'+k^2X=0$.

steps.title: Keep the finite tip solution
steps.why: The two branches are $J_0(kx)$ and $Y_0(kx)$, but a physical displacement cannot diverge at the tip.

steps.title: Write the free-end condition
steps.why: The axial force $EA(l)X'(l)$ vanishes at a free end; since $A(l)\ne0$, the derivative must vanish.

steps.title: Find positive frequencies
steps.why: A positive-frequency mode has $k>0$, so the previous equation cannot be satisfied by choosing $k=0$.

steps.title: Handle the zero mode separately
steps.why: Dividing by $k$ would lose $k=0$, so it must be checked in the original equation.
steps.work: For $k=0$, $(xX')'=0$, and the finite solution is $X=$constant, representing rigid translation rather than positive-frequency vibration.

check: $cj_{1n}/l$ has units $1/$time because $j_{1n}$ is dimensionless and $c/l$ is a frequency.
At $x=l$, $X'(l)=-C(j_{1n}/l)J_1(j_{1n})=0$, so the free boundary is satisfied.
Do not keep $Y_0$; it diverges at $x=0$ and violates tip finiteness.

zh.question: 为什么 $1/(4\pi r)$ 不符合本章 $\Delta G=\delta$ 的基本解符号？
zh.given: $r=|\mathbf r|$，候选函数为 $g(r)=1/(4\pi r)$。点源系数可由包围原点的小球通量求出。
zh.goal: 判断 $\Delta g$ 的符号，并写出满足 $\Delta G=\delta$ 的 $G$。

steps.title: 先查源点外
steps.why: 基本解必须在没有点源的地方满足齐次方程。

steps.title: 计算径向导数
steps.why: 穿过小球面的通量就是点源强度。
steps.work: $g'(r)=-1/(4\pi r^2)$；半径为 $\varepsilon$ 的球面面积是 $4\pi\varepsilon^2$。

steps.title: 求小球通量
steps.why: 散度定理把 $\Delta g$ 在小球内的积分变成边界通量。

steps.title: 修正整体符号
steps.why: 通量为 $-1$ 表示候选函数产生的是负单位点源。
steps.work: 因此 $\Delta g=-\delta$；把函数整体乘 $-1$，得到 $G(r)=-1/(4\pi r)$ 且 $\Delta G=\delta$。

check: $G'(r)=1/(4\pi r^2)$，故小球通量为 $4\pi\varepsilon^2G'(\varepsilon)=1$。
对任意 $r>0$，$G$ 仍满足 $\Delta G=0$；点源只在 $r=0$。
若题目改用算符 $-\Delta$，则 $1/(4\pi r)$ 的正号反而正确。

en.question: Why does $1/(4\pi r)$ have the wrong sign for this chapter's convention $\Delta G=\delta$?
en.given: $r=|\mathbf r|$, and the candidate is $g(r)=1/(4\pi r)$. The point-source coefficient can be found from the flux through a small sphere around the origin.
en.goal: Determine the sign of $\Delta g$, then satisfy $\Delta G=\delta$ by writing $G$.

steps.title: Check away from the source
steps.why: A fundamental solution must satisfy the homogeneous equation wherever there is no point source.
steps.work: For $r>0$, the radial formula gives $\Delta g=r^{-2}(r^2g')'=r^{-2}[-1/(4\pi)]'=0$.

steps.title: Differentiate radially
steps.why: The flux through a small sphere is the strength of the point source.
steps.work: $g'(r)=-1/(4\pi r^2)$, while a sphere of radius $\varepsilon$ has area $4\pi\varepsilon^2$.

steps.title: Compute the small-sphere flux
steps.why: The divergence theorem converts the integral of $\Delta g$ over the ball into boundary flux.

steps.title: Correct the overall sign
steps.why: Flux $-1$ means that the candidate produces a negative unit point source.
steps.work: Therefore $\Delta g=-\delta$. Multiplying the function by $-1$ gives $G(r)=-1/(4\pi r)$ and $\Delta G=\delta$.

check: $G'(r)=1/(4\pi r^2)$, so its small-sphere flux is $4\pi\varepsilon^2G'(\varepsilon)=1$.
For every $r>0$, $G$ still satisfies $\Delta G=0$; the point source occurs only at $r=0$.
If the operator were $-\Delta$, the positive sign in $1/(4\pi r)$ would instead be correct.

zh.question: 怎样构造三维上半空间中零边界、单位点源的 Dirichlet 格林函数？
zh.given: 区域是 $y>0$，真实源点为 $\mathbf r_0=(x_0,y_0,z_0)$ 且 $y_0>0$。约定 $\Delta G=\delta(\mathbf r-\mathbf r_0)$，并要求 $G=0$ 于 $y=0$。
zh.goal: 用镜像法写出 $G$，并逐项检查点源和边界。

steps.title: 放置镜像源
steps.why: 关于平面反射后，边界上任一点到两源的距离相等。
steps.work: 把镜像点放在 $\mathbf r_0^*=(x_0,-y_0,z_0)$，并定义 $R=|\mathbf r-\mathbf r_0|$、$R_*=|\mathbf r-\mathbf r_0^*|$。

steps.title: 写真实源项
steps.why: 本章采用 $\Delta G=+\delta$，所以三维单位点源前必须带负号。
steps.work: 真实源贡献取 $-1/(4\pi R)$，它在 $\mathbf r=\mathbf r_0$ 产生单位正点源。

steps.title: 选择镜像符号
steps.why: 要让平面上的两个等距离项相消，镜像项必须与真实源项异号。
steps.work: 取 $G=-1/(4\pi R)+1/(4\pi R_*)$；镜像点位于 $y<0$，所以第二项在求解区域 $y>0$ 内没有奇点。

steps.title: 检查平面边界
steps.why: Dirichlet 格林函数最关键的附加条件是边界值为零。

steps.title: 得到边界核
steps.why: 若边界值不是零，格林公式还需要 $G$ 的外法向导数。
steps.work: 边界外法向为 $-\mathbf e_y$；求导后得到 $P=\frac{y}{2\pi[(x-\xi)^2+y^2+(z-\zeta)^2]^{3/2}}$，且 $\int_{\mathbb R^2}P\,d\xi d\zeta=1$。

check: 域内只有 $R=0$ 的真实奇点，$R_*=0$ 位于区域外。
在 $y=0$ 上有 $R=R_*$，两个倒数项严格相消。
边界核 $P$ 为正且积分为 $1$，所以常边界值 $C$ 会返回常数解 $u=C$。

en.question: How do we construct the Dirichlet Green function for a unit point source in the three-dimensional upper half-space with zero boundary values?
en.given: The domain is $y>0$, with real source $\mathbf r_0=(x_0,y_0,z_0)$ and $y_0>0$. Use $\Delta G=\delta(\mathbf r-\mathbf r_0)$ and require $G=0$ on $y=0$.
en.goal: Use the image method to write $G$, then check the point source and boundary term by term.

steps.title: Place the image source
steps.why: After reflection across the plane, every boundary point is equally far from the two sources.
steps.work: Put the image at $\mathbf r_0^*=(x_0,-y_0,z_0)$, and define $R=|\mathbf r-\mathbf r_0|$ and $R_*=|\mathbf r-\mathbf r_0^*|$.

steps.title: Write the real-source term
steps.why: This chapter uses $\Delta G=+\delta$, so the three-dimensional unit-source term needs a minus sign.
steps.work: Use $-1/(4\pi R)$ for the real source; it produces a positive unit point source at $\mathbf r=\mathbf r_0$.

steps.title: Choose the image sign
steps.why: The two equal-distance terms must have opposite signs to cancel on the plane.
steps.work: Take $G=-1/(4\pi R)+1/(4\pi R_*)$. The image lies in $y<0$, so the second term has no singularity in the solution domain $y>0$.

steps.title: Check the plane boundary
steps.why: The defining extra condition for a Dirichlet Green function is a zero boundary value.

steps.title: Obtain the boundary kernel
steps.why: For nonzero prescribed boundary data, Green's formula also needs the outward normal derivative of $G$.
steps.work: The outward normal is $-\mathbf e_y$. Differentiation gives $P=\frac{y}{2\pi[(x-\xi)^2+y^2+(z-\zeta)^2]^{3/2}}$, with $\int_{\mathbb R^2}P\,d\xi d\zeta=1$.

check: The only singularity in the domain is the real one at $R=0$; $R_*=0$ lies outside.
On $y=0$, $R=R_*$, so the two reciprocal-distance terms cancel exactly.
The kernel $P$ is positive and integrates to $1$, so constant boundary data $C$ returns the constant solution $u=C$.

zh.question: 区间 $(0,L)$ 上的 $u''=1$ 配合 $u'(0)=u'(L)=0$ 是否有解？
zh.given: $L>0$，方程给定内部总源，两个端点给定导数。Neumann 问题必须先检查总源与边界通量是否相容。
zh.goal: 判断原问题是否有解，并说明相容时为什么仍差一个常数。

steps.title: 先积分方程
steps.why: 对全区间积分会直接得到总源与端点通量之间的必要关系。

steps.title: 代入原边界
steps.why: 相容条件不满足时，无论怎样积分都不可能得到解。
steps.work: 原条件给 $u'(L)-u'(0)=0-0=0$，却要求它等于 $L>0$，因此原问题无解。

steps.title: 看一个相容版本
steps.why: 把右端导数改成 $L$，可以看清求解过程以及剩余自由度。

steps.title: 用归一化定常数
steps.why: Neumann 条件只含导数，不能区分相差常数的两个函数。

check: 把任意常数加到 $u$ 上都不改变 $u''$ 和两个导数边界，这正是常数自由度。
原问题的矛盾是总量矛盾，不是积分常数选择错误。

en.question: On $(0,L)$, does $u''=1$ with $u'(0)=u'(L)=0$ have a solution?
en.given: $L>0$; the equation specifies the total interior source, while derivatives are prescribed at both endpoints. A Neumann problem first requires compatibility between total source and boundary flux.
en.goal: Decide whether the original problem has a solution, then explain why a compatible problem still has an arbitrary constant.

steps.title: Integrate the equation first
steps.why: Integrating over the whole interval directly gives the necessary relation between total source and endpoint flux.
steps.work: $\int_0^L u''(x)dx=u'(L)-u'(0)$, while $\int_0^L1dx=L$, so we must have $u'(L)-u'(0)=L$.

steps.title: Insert the original boundary data
steps.why: If compatibility fails, no choice of integration constants can produce a solution.
steps.work: The original conditions give $u'(L)-u'(0)=0-0=0$, but it must equal $L>0$. Therefore the original problem has no solution.

steps.title: Study a compatible version
steps.why: Changing the right derivative to $L$ shows both the solution process and the remaining freedom.
steps.work: If $u'(0)=0$ and $u'(L)=L$, integration gives $u'=x+C_1$, and $u'(0)=0$ gives $C_1=0$. Integrating again gives $u=x^2/2+C_2$.

steps.title: Fix the constant by normalization
steps.why: Neumann conditions contain only derivatives, so they cannot distinguish functions that differ by a constant.
steps.work: If zero mean is also required, then $L^{-1}\int_0^L u\,dx=L^2/6+C_2=0$, so $C_2=-L^2/6$.

check: For the compatible solution $u=x^2/2+C_2$, we have $u''=1$, $u'(0)=0$, and $u'(L)=L$.
Adding any constant to $u$ changes neither $u''$ nor the two derivative boundaries, which is exactly the constant freedom.
The contradiction in the original problem is a total-balance failure, not a bad choice of integration constants.

zh.question: 为什么只检查 $R>0$ 的方程，不能证明 $g_C(R)=Ce^{ikR}/R$ 是单位点源基本解？
zh.given: $R=|\mathbf r-\mathbf r'|$，算符为 $\Delta+k^2$，并要求 $(\Delta+k^2)G=\delta$。常数 $C$ 尚未确定。
zh.goal: 分别检查源点外方程和源点通量，从而定出 $C$。

steps.title: 检查源点外
steps.why: 径向 Helmholtz 方程在 $R>0$ 可通过令 $v=Rg_C$ 化成常系数方程。
steps.work: $v(R)=Ce^{ikR}$，所以 $v''+k^2v=(-k^2+k^2)Ce^{ikR}=0$；因此任意 $C$ 都通过 $R>0$ 的检查。

steps.title: 展开源点附近
steps.why: 点源强度只由 $1/R$ 奇异项决定，正则项不会留下有限小球通量。

steps.title: 计算通量
steps.why: $k^2g_C$ 的小球体积分趋于零，单位点源系数由导数通量给出。

steps.title: 归一化单位点源
steps.why: 方程右端是系数为 $1$ 的 $\delta$，所以通量极限必须等于 $1$。

steps.title: 再选辐射方向
steps.why: 点源归一化只确定系数；出射或入射还要由时间约定和辐射条件选择。
steps.work: 采用时间因子 $e^{-i\omega t}$ 时，$e^{ikR}$ 对应出射波；$e^{-ikR}$ 也有相同的点源归一化，但对应入射波。

check: 若误取 $C=-1/(2\pi)$，通量为 $2$，对应强度为 $2$ 的点源。
$k^2\int_{R<\varepsilon}g_CdV=O(\varepsilon^2)\to0$，不会改变点源系数。
把 $G$ 乘以 $R$ 后是指数函数，直接满足 $v''+k^2v=0$。

en.question: Why is checking the equation only for $R>0$ insufficient to prove that $g_C(R)=Ce^{ikR}/R$ is a unit-source fundamental solution?
en.given: $R=|\mathbf r-\mathbf r'|$, the operator is $\Delta+k^2$, and $(\Delta+k^2)G=\delta$ is required. The constant $C$ is unknown.
en.goal: Check the equation away from the source and the source flux separately, then determine $C$.

steps.title: Check away from the source
steps.why: For $R>0$, the radial Helmholtz equation becomes a constant-coefficient equation after setting $v=Rg_C$.
steps.work: $v(R)=Ce^{ikR}$, so $v''+k^2v=(-k^2+k^2)Ce^{ikR}=0$. Thus every $C$ passes the $R>0$ check.

steps.title: Expand near the source
steps.why: Only the singular $1/R$ term determines point-source strength; regular terms leave no finite small-sphere flux.

steps.title: Compute the flux
steps.why: The small-ball volume integral of $k^2g_C$ vanishes, so the derivative flux supplies the unit-source coefficient.

steps.title: Normalize the unit source
steps.why: The coefficient $1$ multiplying $\delta$ requires the limiting flux to equal $1$.
steps.work: Set $-4\pi C=1$ to obtain $C=-1/(4\pi)$, hence $G=-e^{ikR}/(4\pi R)$.

steps.title: Select the radiation direction
steps.why: Source normalization fixes the coefficient, while outgoing or incoming behavior still requires a time convention and radiation condition.
steps.work: With time factor $e^{-i\omega t}$, $e^{ikR}$ is outgoing. The choice $e^{-ikR}$ has the same point-source normalization but is incoming.

check: If $C=-1/(2\pi)$ were used, the flux would be $2$, corresponding to a point source of strength $2$.
$k^2\int_{R<\varepsilon}g_CdV=O(\varepsilon^2)\to0$, so it does not alter the point-source coefficient.
After multiplying $G$ by $R$, the result is an exponential that directly satisfies $v''+k^2v=0$.

zh.question: 原点从 $t=0$ 起持续施加 $f(\mathbf r,t)=\delta(\mathbf r)H(t)$，零初值响应是什么？
zh.given: 算符为 $\partial_t^2-c^2\Delta$，三维推迟格林函数是 $G_{\rm ret}=\delta(t-t'-R/c)/(4\pi c^2R)$。这里 $R=|\mathbf r-\mathbf r'|$，且 $c>0$。
zh.goal: 完成时空卷积，并说明信号到达前后的响应。

steps.title: 写出卷积
steps.why: 线性方程的响应是格林函数与源在全部源点和源时刻上的叠加。
steps.work: $u(\mathbf r,t)=\int d^3r'\int dt'\,\frac{\delta(t-t'-|\mathbf r-\mathbf r'|/c)}{4\pi c^2|\mathbf r-\mathbf r'|}\delta(\mathbf r')H(t')$。

steps.title: 先算空间积分
steps.why: 空间 $\delta(\mathbf r')$ 只保留原点这个源位置。
steps.work: 令 $\mathbf r'=0$ 后，$|\mathbf r-\mathbf r'|=R=|\mathbf r|$，所以 $u(R,t)=\frac1{4\pi c^2R}\int dt'\,\delta(t-t'-R/c)H(t')$。

steps.title: 再算时间积分
steps.why: 时间 δ 函数只取推迟时刻，表示传播需要时间 $R/c$。
steps.work: 零点是 $t'=t-R/c$，且 $|d(t-t'-R/c)/dt'|=1$，故积分等于 $H(t-R/c)$，没有额外的 $c$ 因子。

steps.title: 写出响应
steps.why: 把两次积分的结果合并，就得到完整的因果解。

steps.title: 分到达前后解释
steps.why: 阶跃函数把有限传播速度直接变成一个清楚的分段结果。

check: 到达时间为 $t=R/c$；把距离加倍会把等待时间也加倍。
到达后响应含 $1/R$，把距离加倍会把幅值减半。
当 $t<0$ 时必有 $t<R/c$，所以 $u=0$，满足零初值的因果要求。

en.question: From $t=0$, a source $f(\mathbf r,t)=\delta(\mathbf r)H(t)$ acts continuously at the origin. What is the zero-initial-data response?
en.given: The operator is $\partial_t^2-c^2\Delta$, and the three-dimensional retarded Green function is $G_{\rm ret}=\delta(t-t'-R/c)/(4\pi c^2R)$. Here $R=|\mathbf r-\mathbf r'|$ and $c>0$.
en.goal: Carry out the space-time convolution and explain the response before and after signal arrival.

steps.title: Write the convolution
steps.why: For a linear equation, the response is the Green function summed over all source positions and source times.
steps.work: $u(\mathbf r,t)=\int d^3r'\int dt'\,\frac{\delta(t-t'-|\mathbf r-\mathbf r'|/c)}{4\pi c^2|\mathbf r-\mathbf r'|}\delta(\mathbf r')H(t')$.

steps.title: Do the spatial integral first
steps.why: The spatial $\delta(\mathbf r')$ keeps only the source position at the origin.
steps.work: After setting $\mathbf r'=0$, $|\mathbf r-\mathbf r'|=R=|\mathbf r|$, so $u(R,t)=\frac1{4\pi c^2R}\int dt'\,\delta(t-t'-R/c)H(t')$.

steps.title: Do the time integral
steps.why: The time delta selects the retarded time, showing that propagation requires time $R/c$.
steps.work: Its zero is $t'=t-R/c$, and $|d(t-t'-R/c)/dt'|=1$. Thus the integral is $H(t-R/c)$ with no extra factor of $c$.

steps.title: Write the response
steps.why: Combining the two integrations gives the complete causal solution.

steps.title: Interpret before and after arrival
steps.why: The step function turns finite propagation speed into a clear piecewise result.

check: The arrival time is $t=R/c$; doubling the distance doubles the waiting time.
After arrival, the response contains $1/R$, so doubling the distance halves the amplitude.
When $t<0$, we necessarily have $t<R/c$, so $u=0$, satisfying zero-initial-data causality.
